Once cooked, lower the heat and add 5g extra butter, minced garlic, and parsley. Stir until each piece is evenly coated in the rich, garlic butter, then transfer to a plate. Repeat this process for the remaining chicken.

Back to the pan on low heat, add evaporated milk with garlic & herb cream cheese. Stir until the cheese melts and the sauce thickens slightly for about 5 minutes. Add the crispy potatoes in the sauce, gently mix until well combined and creamy.
Finally serve and distribute into equal servings with the delicious chicken and your high protein meals are ready for the week, ENJOY!
macroNote: Cook chicken on medium-high heat for 3–4 minutes per side until golden brown. Avoid overcrowding. Lower heat before adding butter, garlic, and parsley. Stir for 1 minute to coat evenly. Keep pan on low heat when adding milk and cream cheese. Stir continuously for 5 minutes until slightly thickened, then add cooked potatoes. Reheat in a pan on low for 4–5 minutes or microwave for 5 minutes.

title: Philly Cheese Steak Mac n Cheese
ingredients: 20g (0.7oz) Grass Fed Butter (or any butter for cooking)
1.5 Tsp each Salt, Pepper, Paprika, Chilli Flakes
125g (½ Cup or 4.5oz) Pasta Water (after the pasta is cooked)
instructions: Bring a large pot of water to a boil. Add the macaroni and cook for 7–8 minutes until slightly underdone. Before draining, reserve 1 cup of pasta water (keep extra on hand if needed). Drain the pasta and set it aside.

While the pasta cooks, heat a pan over medium heat. Melt the butter, then add the minced garlic, chopped onion, and mixed bell peppers. Sauté for 5–6 minutes until the vegetables become soft and fragrant.

Push the vegetables to the edges of the pan to create a central well. Add the minced beef along with salt, pepper, paprika, and chilli flakes. Break the beef into small pieces with a spatula and cook on high heat for 6–8 minutes until it is fully browned. Once browned, mix the beef with the vegetables.

Reduce the heat to low and add the cream cheese, shredded mozzarella, cheese slices, and the reserved pasta water. Stir continuously until the cheese melts and the sauce becomes smooth, creamy, and well combined with the beef and vegetables.

Lastly add the cooked macaroni into the sauce, mixing thoroughly to ensure everything is well coated. If needed, add extra pasta water to adjust the consistency. Finally, distribute the dish evenly into 4 servings, garnish with parsley, and ENJOY!
macroNote: Remove the veggies when cooking the beef or make a well in the center as instructed in Step 3. Cook the beef thoroughly (add an extra 2–3 minutes if needed) before mixing in the cream cheese and mozzarella. Lower the heat before adding any dairy ingredients to prevent curdling.

title: Creamy Honey Garlic Steak Noodles
ingredients: 80g (2.8oz) Gochujang Paste (adjust to your spice level)
125g (½ Cup) Noodle/Pasta Water (from the boiled noodles)
Garnish: Green Onion, Sesame Seeds, Parmesan Cheese
instructions: Dice the beef into 1-inch cubes. Season with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, and olive oil. Mix thoroughly until evenly coated, then set aside to marinate.
Bring a pot of water to a boil, then add raw noodles and cook for 4–5 minutes or according to packet instructions. Do not overcook.
Reserve 1 cup of noodle water, then drain and rinse noodles under cold water to stop cooking. Set aside.
Heat a pan on medium heat, melt butter, and sear the steak bites for 3–4 minutes per side until golden and charred.
Lower the heat, then add more butter, minced garlic, a drizzle of honey, and chopped parsley. Mix for 1 minute until the steak is coated and juicy. Set aside and repeat for remaining steak.
In the same pan on low heat, sauté minced garlic in the leftover butter for 2 minutes until fragrant. Add gochujang paste and stir for 1–2 minutes until combined.

Pour in milk, cream cheese, and grated parmesan. Stir continuously until melted and smooth, then add reserved noodle water and mix again. Let the sauce thicken for 1–2 minutes, then add the cooked noodles. Gently mix to coat well.
Serve the creamy gochujang noodles with the juicy steak bites. Garnish as desired and ENJOY!
macroNote: Cook/boil the noodles first as you'll need noodle water for the creamy sauce. To reheat, simply place in a pot or pan on low heat for 5 mins. Add a little milk or water to the noodles to help liquify the sauce.

title: Creamy Garlic Cheesy Chicken & Potatoes
ingredients: ½ Tsp each Salt, Garlic Powder, Mixed Herbs
1 Tsp each Salt, Garlic Powder, Mixed Herbs, Paprika
instructions: Cut the chicken breasts into cubes. In a bowl, combine with minced garlic, onion powder, mixed herbs, chilli flakes, paprika, salt, and olive oil. Mix well until evenly coated, then set aside.
Slice the potatoes into cubes and place them in a mixing bowl. Season with salt, garlic powder, mixed herbs, chilli flakes, paprika, and olive oil. Toss thoroughly to coat each piece.
Spread the seasoned potatoes onto a lined baking sheet (use baking paper). Oven bake or air fry at 200°C/400°F for 20–23 minutes until golden brown and crispy.

While the potatoes cook, heat a large pan over medium-high heat and melt the butter. Cook the chicken in batches, stirring occasionally, for 6–8 minutes until golden brown. Once all the chicken is cooked, lower the heat and return all the chicken to the pan.

With the heat on low, add milk, cream cheese, parmesan, salt, garlic, and mixed herbs to the pan. Stir continuously until it all melts into a smooth sauce, then let it simmer for 3–4 minutes until slightly thickened.
By now, the potatoes should be ready. Add them to the pan with the creamy chicken and mix thoroughly until creamy and well combined.
Sprinkle shredded mozzarella and fresh parsley over the dish. Cover with a lid and let it sit on low heat for 3–4 minutes until the cheese melts. Divide into 4 servings and ENJOY!
macroNote: Avoid burning or drying out the potatoes. Use cooking spray instead of olive oil if preferred. After cooking the chicken, lower the heat before adding milk and cream cheese to prevent overheating.

title: Creamy Cajun Chicken & Rice
ingredients: 1 Tsp each: Salt, Black Pepper, Garlic Powder, Onion Powder, Oregano, Thyme, Paprika, Chilli Powder
instructions: Butterfly the chicken breasts into thinner halves. Season with 1.5 servings of Cajun spice mix and olive oil. Mix until both sides are fully coated, then let it marinate.
Cook the plain white rice for later. Bring a pot of water to a boil, add basmati rice, and cook for 8–10 minutes until fully cooked and fluffy. Drain and set aside.
Heat a pan over medium heat, melt butter, and cook the chicken fillets in batches for 3–4 minutes per side until golden and charred, then set aside.

Using the same pan with the flavorful butter left behind, keep the heat on medium and add chopped onion and garlic. Sauté for 5 minutes until fragrant, then stir in ½ serving of Cajun spice mix. Cook for 2–3 minutes until the spices are toasted and aromatic.
Add the cooked rice to the pan and mix thoroughly until every grain is coated and takes on the color of the spices. Stir in fresh parsley, then set aside.

For the creamy sauce, on low heat melt butter in a pan, then stir in ½ serving of Cajun spice mix. Toast for 1–2 minutes before adding milk, cream cheese, and parmesan. Stir over low heat for 4–5 minutes until smooth and slightly thickened.
Slice the cooked chicken into strips and serve over the spiced rice. Drizzle with the creamy sauce, garnish with fresh parsley, and enjoy your high-protein meals for the week!
macroNote: Marinate the chicken overnight for maximum flavor, ensuring each piece is well coated on both sides. Cook on medium-high heat to develop a crispy crust, then let it rest before slicing. Keep the heat low when making the sauce. Store separately and serve with the chicken and rice when ready to eat.

title: Garlic Butter Steak Bites
ingredients: 800g (28oz) Raw Topside/Top Sirloin Beef, 1 inch cubed
15g (1 Tbsp) Sriracha or any Hot Sauce
instructions: Cut the steaks into 1-inch cubes. Season with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, parsley, and olive oil. Mix thoroughly until evenly coated, then set aside.

Dice the uncooked potatoes into small cubes and place them in a bowl. Season with salt, black pepper, smoked paprika, garlic powder, parsley, and a drizzle of olive oil (optional). Mix well, then spread them on a lined baking sheet (use baking paper). Oven bake or air fry at 200°C/400°F for 20–22 minutes until crispy and golden.
While the potatoes cook, heat a pan over medium-high heat and melt 10g butter. Sear the half of the steak bites for 2–3 minutes per side until a rich, golden crust forms.

Lower the heat and add 10g extra butter, minced garlic, and chopped parsley. Stir for 1–2 minutes until the steak bites are fully coated in this garlic butter, then remove from heat. Repeat for the second batches.

Prepare the spicy mayo by mixing light mayo, sriracha, and lemon juice in a bowl. Serve the steak bites with the crispy potatoes, drizzle with the spicy mayo, and enjoy your high-protein meals for the week!
macroNote: Slice beef into 1-inch cubes to keep it juicy and develop a nice crust. Air fry steak bites for 12–15 minutes at 200°C (400°F) as an alternative. Use store-bought spicy mayo or make your own. Reheat in an air fryer or oven for 5 minutes at 180°C (370°F), or in a pan on low heat for 4–5 minutes.

title: Crispy Garlic Chicken Fried Rice
ingredients: 1000g (35oz) Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, cubed
Extra Seasoning: 1 Tsp each Black Pepper, Onion Powder, Parsley
20g (1oz) Dark Soy Sauce (add more if needed)
Garlic Yum Yum Sauce (enough for 8+ meals):
Dash of Milk or Water for desired consistency
instructions: Slice the boneless, skinless chicken thighs into bite-sized cubes. Season with black pepper, chilli flakes, garlic powder, onion powder, light and dark soy sauce, and olive oil. Mix thoroughly until well coated and the colour deepens. Set aside to marinate.

To make the Garlic Yum Yum sauce, combine light mayo, ketchup, sriracha, minced garlic, ginger powder, and rice vinegar in a bowl. Mix until completely smooth. Add a splash of milk or water to adjust the consistency if needed. Bottle and store in the fridge to use throughout the week.

Heat a pan over medium heat and melt a little butter. Cook the marinated chicken for about 5 minutes per side until golden, crispy, and cooked through. Add a handful of freshly chopped parsley, stir to coat the chicken well, then set aside to rest.
In the same pan, add a knob of butter and the chopped onion. Cook on medium heat for 8 to 10 minutes, stirring halfway through, until softened and caramelised.

Add chopped green onion (white part) and finely chopped carrots. Season with black pepper, onion powder, and parsley. Stir everything together until fragrant, then push the vegetables to one side of the pan.
In the empty side of the pan, pour in the beaten eggs. Stir continuously until scrambled and fully cooked, then mix in with the sautéed vegetables.

Add your leftover cooked rice to the pan, followed by soy sauce, oyster sauce, and chopped green onion (green part). Mix everything thoroughly until well combined and each grain of rice catches a deep colour. Add more soy sauce, if needed.
Serve the fried rice with the crispy chicken in 5 equal portions. Drizzle with Garlic Yum Yum sauce, garnish with sesame seeds, and ENJOY!

title: Honey BBQ Chicken & Garlic Parmesan Potatoes
ingredients: 160g (5.6oz) Sugar Free BBQ Sauce (Brand: G Hughes)
instructions: Slice the chicken breasts into bite-sized cubes. Season with garlic powder, smoked paprika, cumin, salt, black pepper, and olive oil. Mix thoroughly until the chicken is well coated and the colour deepens. Set aside to marinate while you prepare the potatoes.

Slice the raw potatoes into small, even cubes and place them in a large mixing bowl. Season with salt, Italian herbs, smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, grated parmesan, and olive oil. Mix well until all the potatoes are evenly coated. Spread them out in a single layer on a lined baking tray (use baking paper for easy cleanup). Oven bake or air fry at 200°C (400°F) for 20–22 minutes until golden and crispy.

Heat a pan over medium heat and melt some butter. Add the marinated chicken and cook for 5 minutes per side, or until seared and golden brown. Once cooked, lower the heat and stir in a drizzle of honey, BBQ sauce, and freshly chopped parsley. Mix everything together until the chicken is well coated and juicy. Set aside.

In a blender, combine cottage cheese and milk. Blend for 2 minutes until completely smooth. Pour the mixture into the same pan on low heat. Add Italian herbs, garlic powder, and grated parmesan. Stir gently as the sauce warms through and begins to thicken slightly. Do not boil the sauce - overheating will cause it to split.
Add the crispy roasted potatoes to the sauce. Stir gently to coat each piece in the creamy mixture. If the sauce is too thick, adjust with a splash of milk until you reach your desired consistency.
Serve the creamy potatoes with the BBQ chicken, dividing evenly into 5 portions. Your high-protein meal prep is ready to ENJOY!

title: Garlic Alfredo Steak & Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 1000g (35oz) Raw Topside/Top Sirloin Beef, 1 inch cubed
Pinch of Chilli Flakes (omit for no spice)
1/2 Tsp Chilli Flakes (omit for no spice)
instructions: Slice the beef steaks into 1-inch cubes. Season generously with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, parsley, and olive oil. Mix thoroughly until the steak bites are evenly coated, then set aside to marinate while you prep the potatoes.

Wash, peel, and chop the potatoes into thick, even chunks. Place them in a pot of cold water, bring to a boil, and cook for 12–14 minutes until just fork-tender. Drain the water, then cover the pot with a lid and let the potatoes steam for 5 minutes—this helps soften them further for a smooth mash.

Use a potato masher to mash the steamed potatoes gently until smooth and fluffy. Avoid over-mashing to keep the texture light. Add a knob of butter, cream cheese, milk, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper. Mix gently until fully combined and creamy.

Heat a pan over medium-high heat, add butter, and sear the marinated steak bites for 2–3 minutes on each side until golden brown and crusted. Lower the heat, then add more butter, minced garlic, chilli flakes, and chopped parsley. Toss the steak bites in the buttery glaze until coated and aromatic, then set aside.

In a blender, combine cottage cheese and milk. Blend for 2 minutes until smooth. Back in the same pan over low heat, melt a small amount of butter. Add smoked paprika, chilli flakes, salt, mustard, plenty of minced garlic, and parsley. Sauté for 5 minutes until fragrant. Pour in the blended cottage cheese and stir until the Alfredo sauce becomes creamy and slightly thick. Remove from heat.
To serve, portion the creamy mash and steak bites into 5 meal prep containers. Drizzle generously with the homemade Alfredo sauce. Your flavour-packed high-protein meals are ready to ENJOY!

title: Chicken Shawarma Rice Bowls
ingredients: Special Garlic White Sauce (big batch, store in bottle):
25g (1oz) Pickle Juice (add to your desired consistency)
Fresh Crunchy Slaw (big batch, store separately):
instructions: Place boneless, skinless chicken thighs into a large mixing bowl. Add minced garlic, your homemade shawarma spice mix, tomato paste, olive oil, and a squeeze of fresh lemon juice. Mix thoroughly until the chicken is evenly coated and vibrant in colour. Set aside to marinate for at least 30 minutes-or longer for deeper flavour. Be patient-it's worth it!

For the garlic white sauce, combine yogurt, light mayo, honey, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and a splash of pickle juice for added tang. Mix until smooth and creamy, then bottle it up and store in the fridge. It'll keep well for multiple meals throughout the week.

Heat a pan on medium, melt a knob of butter, then sauté minced garlic and chopped onions for 5–6 minutes until softened and fragrant. Add turmeric, smoked paprika, and salt, then stir until the onions take on a deep yellow colour. Add washed basmati rice and toast for 2–3 minutes to build flavour. Pour in double the amount of water (e.g. 1 cup rice = 2 cups water), bring to a gentle bubble, stir once, cover with a lid, and reduce to a low simmer for 10–12 minutes. Check halfway and gently mix to avoid sticking and ensure even cooking.

Spread the marinated chicken thighs evenly on a lined sheet pan. Bake or air fry at 200°C (400°F) for 20–23 minutes until golden, slightly charred, and juicy. Once cooked, let the chicken rest for 5 minutes before slicing into bite-size cubes.

To make the slaw, combine thinly sliced red onion, halved cherry tomatoes, chopped pickled gherkins, and fresh parsley in a bowl. Season with salt, black pepper, sumac, and a drizzle of olive oil. Toss until fully combined. For meal prep, store this slaw in a separate container to keep it crisp and fresh.

To serve, divide the golden turmeric rice into 5 meal prep containers with the juicy shawarma chicken, a portion of the fresh slaw, and finish with a generous drizzle of the garlic white sauce. Your high-protein shawarma bowls are prepped and ready to ENJOY!

title: Chicken Fajita Mac n Cheese
ingredients: Fajita Veggie Mix (Half for Chicken/Half for Mac):
instructions: Slice boneless, skinless chicken breasts into bite-size cubes and place them in a mixing bowl. Season with salt, oregano, smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, cumin, and a drizzle of olive oil. Mix thoroughly until the chicken is evenly coated and takes on a deep reddish hue. Set aside to marinate for at least 20–30 minutes.

Bring a pot of water to a boil and cook the macaroni pasta for 8–10 minutes, or until al dente. Once cooked, reserve a little pasta water (optional), drain the rest, and set the pasta aside for later.

Heat a large pan over medium-high heat, melt a little butter, then add finely chopped onions and red, yellow, and green bell peppers. Cook for 5–6 minutes until softened and fragrant. Add a generous amount of fajita seasoning and minced garlic, and continue cooking for another 4-5 minutes, stirring occasionally, until the veggies are golden and slightly caramelised. Transfer this fajita veggie mix to a bowl and set aside.

In the same pan, melt a bit more butter and cook the marinated chicken on medium heat for 5 minutes per side, or until golden brown and seared. Lower the heat, then add a few spoonfuls of the fajita veggie mix, a drizzle of honey, and fresh chopped parsley. Toss the chicken until well coated in the sweet, savoury mixture. Set aside and repeat if cooking in batches.

To the same pan on medium-low heat, return the remaining fajita veggie mix. Pour in the blended cheese sauce (made from milk, cream cheese, and cottage cheese, blended until smooth). Stir continuously until the sauce is warm and velvety, then add low-fat cheddar cheese. Let it melt and thicken slightly, stirring as needed.

Add your cooked macaroni to the pan and gently fold it through the sauce until every piece is coated and the mac is ultra creamy. Let it simmer for a minute if needed to reach your preferred consistency.

Serve into 5 meal prep containers, topping each with the juicy fajita chicken. Garnish with fresh parsley or a sprinkle of cheese (optional), and your high-protein Chicken Fajita Mac N Cheese is ready to ENJOY all week long!

title: Orange Chicken Rice Bowls
ingredients: 1000g (35oz) Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, cubed
250g (8.8oz) Uncooked White Rice/690g Cooked (leftover or day old cooked)
1 or 2 Tsp Red Pepper Flakes (omit for no spice)
instructions: Slice the boneless, skinless chicken thighs into bite-size cubes and place them in a mixing bowl. Season with black pepper, garlic and ginger paste, red pepper flakes, honey, sriracha, freshly squeezed orange juice, orange zest, and dark soy sauce. Mix thoroughly until the chicken is fully coated and the colour deepens. Set aside to marinate for at least 30 minutes (or overnight for best flavour).

Heat a large pan on medium heat, melt a small amount of butter, then add sesame seeds. Toast for 5 minutes, stirring occasionally until golden and nutty. Add minced garlic and cook for another 2 minutes until fragrant. Season lightly with salt, then add leftover cooked rice and stir well. Cook for 2–3 minutes until fluffy, toasted, and aromatic. Garnish with chopped green onion and more sesame seeds, then set aside.

While the rice cooks, finely slice your vegetables: cucumber, red onion, carrots, cabbage, and green onion. Place in a large bowl and add rice vinegar, red pepper flakes, and a light drizzle of honey. Toss everything together until well combined. Store this crunchy slaw in a separate airtight container in the fridge - it stays crisp and tangy throughout the week.

Line a baking tray with baking paper, then evenly spread out the marinated chicken. Oven bake or air fry at 200°C (400°F) for 19–22 minutes until golden brown and slightly charred on the edges. Let it rest for a few minutes before serving with all its juices.

Assemble your meal prep: divide the sesame garlic rice, orange-glazed chicken, and crunchy slaw into 5 meal prep containers. Keep the slaw separate if reheating. Your high-protein orange chicken bowls are ready to ENJOY all week!

title: Creamy Cajun Steak & Parmesan Potatoes
ingredients: 1000g (35oz) Raw Topside/Top Sirloin Beef, 1 inch cubed
instructions: Slice the beef sirloin steaks into 1-inch cubes, then place them in a large mixing bowl. Season with salt, Italian herbs, chilli flakes, garlic powder, onion powder, parsley, smoked paprika, and olive oil. Mix thoroughly until each piece is evenly coated and the colour deepens. Set aside to marinate while you prep the veg.

Slice the washed, uncooked potatoes into small cubes. Place them on a large tray along with chopped red onion, broccoli florets, and red bell peppers. Season generously with Italian herbs, garlic powder, paprika, parsley, and grated parmesan. Use clean hands to toss everything thoroughly until all the vegetables are well coated. Add more seasoning if needed.

Transfer the seasoned vegetables onto a lined baking tray. Oven bake or air fry at 180°C (360°F) for 20–24 minutes, or until the potatoes and vegetables are tender, golden, and lightly crisped on the edges. Once done, set aside.

Heat a pan over medium-high heat, melt a little butter, then add the marinated steak bites in a single layer. Cook for 3–4 minutes per side until golden brown and seared. Avoid overcrowding the pan - work in batches if needed. Once cooked, lower the heat and add minced garlic and fresh parsley, stirring until the beef is coated in a garlicky glaze. Set aside to rest.

In the same pan over medium-low heat, melt a bit more butter and toast the extra seasonings for 1–2 minutes until aromatic. Then pour in milk, followed by cream cheese and grated parmesan. Stir continuously until the sauce becomes smooth, melted, and creamy.

Let the sauce simmer gently for 2–3 minutes until it thickens slightly. Then assemble your meals: divide the roasted parmesan potatoes and veggies evenly into 5 portions, top with the juicy steak bites, and drizzle with the creamy sauce. Garnish with extra parsley if desired—and your high-protein meal prep is ready to ENJOY all week!

title: Caramelized Onion Creamy Chicken
ingredients: 350g (12.4oz) Red or White Onion, finely sliced
instructions: Slice the chicken breasts into bite-sized cubes and transfer to a mixing bowl. Season with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, oregano, smoked paprika, dried basil, and a drizzle of olive oil. Mix thoroughly until each piece is evenly coated and the colour deepens. Set aside to marinate.

Heat a large pan over medium heat, melt down a little butter, then add the chicken in a single layer. Sear for 4–5 minutes per side until golden brown and slightly charred. Work in batches if needed. Once cooked, set aside to rest.

In the same pan, reduce heat to medium-low. Add more butter and toss in all the sliced onions. Cook slowly for 15 minutes or longer, stirring occasionally until deep golden and caramelised—this step builds flavour, so take your time. Meanwhile, boil and cook your white basmati rice in a separate pot for later use. Once onions are caramelised, season with salt, black pepper, paprika, and chilli flakes. Then add minced garlic and sun-dried tomatoes, cooking for an additional 2 minutes until fragrant.

Lower the heat fully and pour in milk, followed by cream cheese and grated parmesan. Stir gently and continuously until the mixture is smooth, creamy, and well combined. Now return the seared chicken to the pan along with a handful of freshly chopped parsley, giving everything a final stir until the chicken is coated in the creamy, savoury sauce.

For the rice, use a clean pan or the same one if large enough. On medium heat, melt a small amount of butter, then sauté minced garlic for 2 minutes until aromatic. Add salt to taste and a generous pinch of mixed or Italian herbs. Toast the herbs briefly for 30 seconds to release their oils, then add in the cooked rice.

Mix the rice well so the flavours fully combine. Remove from the heat, then grate over some fresh lemon zest and add a squeeze of lemon juice. Stir one last time until the rice is light, fragrant, and herby.
Evenly portion the lemon butter herb rice and creamy chicken into 5 meal prep containers. Garnish with more parsley if desired, and your high-protein meals are ready to ENJOY all week long!

title: Sweet & Sour Chicken Fried Rice
ingredients: Garnish Sesame Seeds & Red Pepper Flakes
instructions: Slice boneless, skinless chicken thighs into bite-sized cubes and place them into a mixing bowl. Season with black pepper, onion powder, minced garlic, ketchup, pineapple juice, rice vinegar, and soy sauce. Mix thoroughly until the chicken is fully coated and vibrant in colour. Set aside to marinate while prepping the rest.

If you're not using leftover rice, start by boiling a pot of water. Add raw white rice and cook for 8–10 minutes until fluffy and fully cooked. Drain if needed and set aside to cool (cooling prevents clumping later). Meanwhile, dice your fresh pineapple (or drain canned pineapple), and chop red onion and red, yellow, and green bell peppers into small cubes.

Spread the marinated chicken evenly on a lined sheet pan, followed by the chopped pineapple and vegetables. Arrange in a single layer to ensure even cooking—don't overcrowd the tray. If needed, bake in batches. Note: Bell peppers and pineapple will release liquid during baking, so avoid overloading. Drizzle honey lightly across the top for extra glaze and sweetness.

Oven bake at 200°C (400°F) for 30 minutes until the chicken is golden and tender. If using an air fryer, cook at 200°C for 25–30 minutes. If the chicken hasn't browned to your liking, broil for an extra 3–5 minutes, keeping a close eye to avoid burning. The juices in the tray should reduce and create a sticky, caramelised glaze.

Heat a large pan over medium-high heat, melt some butter, then sauté chopped garlic, the white part of green onion, and diced carrots. Cook for 5–6 minutes until soft and fragrant. Push the veggies to one side of the pan.

On the empty side, pour in beaten eggs and stir continuously until fully scrambled. Mix the eggs together with the sautéed vegetables. Add in the leftover cooked rice, a splash of soy sauce, chopped kimchi, and kimchi juice. Finish with the green part of the green onion and stir everything together until well incorporated, fluffy, and full of colour.

Garnish with sesame seeds and red pepper flakes, then distribute the kimchi fried rice and sweet & sour chicken evenly into 5 meal prep containers. Your high-protein, flavour-packed meals are ready to ENJOY all week!

title: Chipotle Beef Potato Bowls
ingredients: 1.5 Tsp Chipotle Chilli Flakes (Omit for less heat)
250g (8.8oz) Low Fat Greek Yogurt (or yogurt of choice)
Tangy Pico De Gallo (enough for 6+ meals):
instructions: Slice the potatoes into small cubes. Season with garlic powder, onion powder, regular or chipotle chilli flakes, parsley, smoked paprika, cumin, and a drizzle of olive oil. Use your hands to mix well until every piece is evenly coated.
Spread the seasoned potatoes on a lined sheet pan and oven bake or air fry at 200°C (400°F) for 20-23 minutes until golden and crispy. Once cooked, sprinkle salt to taste.

While the potatoes cook, prepare the creamy chipotle sauce. In a blender, combine low-fat yogurt, light mayo, chipotle paste, honey, lime juice, salt, garlic powder, and paprika. Blend until smooth, then bottle and refrigerate to use throughout the week.

Heat a pan over high heat, melt butter, and cook the ground beef for 6-8 minutes until browned and fully cooked. Lower the heat to medium, then add salt, garlic powder, onion powder, parsley, paprika, cumin, and chipotle paste. Mix thoroughly. If too dry, add a splash of water, then finish with a drizzle of honey and cook until juicy and golden. Remove from heat.

For the salsa, combine chopped tomatoes, red onion, red and green bell peppers, coriander, salt, pepper, and lime juice in a large bowl. Mix well and store separately to keep fresh and make reheating easier.
Serve into 5 even portions. Store in the fridge and reheat in a microwave or pan when ready to enjoy!

title: Harissa Chicken Rice Bowls
ingredients: 160g (5.6oz) Harissa Paste or Red Pepper Paste
Splash of Pickle Juice (for desired consistency)
300g (10.6oz) Fresh Tomatoes, de seeded & finely chopped
instructions: In a blender or food processor, add roughly chopped tomatoes, a handful of parsley, garlic cloves, onion, red bell pepper, yogurt, harissa paste, salt, smoked paprika, oregano, cumin, and a drizzle of olive oil. Blend in short pulses for 5-8 seconds until slightly chunky - you want texture, not a completely smooth paste.
Add the marinade to the boneless chicken thighs and mix thoroughly with your hands until fully coated. Set aside to marinate while you prepare the rice.

Boil uncooked basmati rice in a pot for 8–10 minutes until fluffy. Meanwhile, heat a pan over medium heat, melt butter, and sauté chopped onions for 5 minutes until soft. Add salt, turmeric, parsley, paprika, and cumin. Toast for 2 minutes, then stir in the cooked rice until it turns golden and fluffy. Set aside.
Spread the marinated chicken evenly on a lined sheet pan. Oven bake or air fry at 200°C (400°F) for 20-25 minutes until golden and juicy. Broil for 2-3 minutes at the end if needed for extra char.

While the chicken cooks, make the creamy harissa sauce: blend low-fat yogurt, light mayo, harissa paste, and a splash of pickle juice until smooth. Bottle and refrigerate. For the salad, combine chopped tomatoes, cucumber, red onion, and parsley in a large bowl. Store separately to keep fresh and make reheating easier.
Once the chicken is done, let it rest for 2–3 minutes, then chop into bite-size pieces. Serve into 5 portions with the golden rice, salad, and creamy harissa sauce. Enjoy your high-protein meals!

title: Honey Butter Chicken Alfredo Pasta
ingredients: 2 Pieces Parmesan Rind - Optional (outer layer, adds so much flavour!)
instructions: Slice the chicken breasts into small cubes and place in a mixing bowl. Season with salt, chilli flakes, parsley, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, and a drizzle of olive oil. Mix thoroughly with your hands until the colour deepens and the chicken is evenly coated. Set aside to marinate.
Bring a pot of water to a boil and add your pasta of choice - linguine works great. Cook for 8 minutes or until al dente. Drain the pasta and set it aside.

Heat a pan on medium heat and melt some butter. Cook the chicken cubes for 3-4 minutes per side until golden brown and crispy. Once cooked, lower the heat and add a little more butter, a drizzle of honey, soy sauce, and fresh parsley. Mix everything well until the chicken is fully glazed and coated in the sauce. Set aside and repeat for the remaining chicken if needed.

In the same pan on medium-low heat, add lots of minced garlic and chopped sun-dried tomatoes. Cook for 3 minutes until soft and fragrant. Then add Italian herbs, salt, low-fat milk, light cream cheese, grated parmesan, and a couple of parmesan rind pieces (optional for depth of flavour). Keep stirring gently until the sauce is completely smooth and slightly thickened.
Add the cooked pasta along with more fresh parsley. Gently mix everything together until the sauce coats each strand and the pasta is creamy and indulgent.
Serve and distribute evenly into 5 meal prep containers with the honey butter chicken. Garnish if desired - your high-protein meals are ready to ENJOY!

title: Philly Cheesesteak Rice Bowls
ingredients: 1000g (35oz) Raw Top Sirloin Beef, sliced into thin strips
instructions: Slice the beef steaks into extra thin strips and place in a mixing bowl. Season with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, Worcestershire sauce, and olive oil. Mix well with your hands until evenly coated, then set aside to marinate.

Heat a pan over medium heat and melt some butter. Add sliced onions and mixed bell peppers, then cook for 5-7 minutes until softened and fragrant. Season with a pinch of salt and pepper, mix well, then set aside.

In the same pan, melt a little more butter on medium heat. Sauté minced garlic for 30 seconds, then add in your leftover cooked rice along with chilli flakes, plenty of grated parmesan, and freshly chopped parsley. Mix everything until fluffy, golden, and aromatic. Set aside once done.

Bring the heat up to medium-high, then add the marinated steak strips in a single layer. Sear for 4-6 minutes until browned and slightly charred. Once cooked, add the sautéed onions and peppers back in. Then add light cheese slices, a splash of milk, and low-fat cheddar cheese. Mix thoroughly until the cheese is melted, creamy, and well combined with the steak and veggies.
Serve and divide the garlic parmesan rice and Philly cheesy steak mix into 5 equal portions. Your high-protein meals are ready to ENJOY!

title: Crispy Nashville Hot Chicken Mac n Cheese
ingredients: Dry Spice Rub - Smoked Paprika, Garlic Powder, Onion Powder (once cooked)
1 Tsp Each: Smoked Paprika, Garlic & Onion Powder
1/2 Tsp each: Black Pepper, Chilli Powder
instructions: Slice the boneless chicken thighs into cubes and place in a mixing bowl. Season with black pepper, smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, chilli powder, baking powder, dark brown sugar, and a drizzle of olive oil. Mix thoroughly with your hands until well coated, then set aside to marinate.
Bring a pot of water to a boil, add the uncooked macaroni, and cook for 8 minutes until al dente. Drain and set aside for later.

Heat a pan on medium heat, melt some butter, then cook the marinated chicken for 5 minutes on each side (don't over crowd the pan) until golden brown with a crispy crust. Lower the heat, add a little more butter, a dry spice mix (smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder), and fresh parsley. Stir until the chicken is juicy and well coated, then set aside. Repeat for any remaining chicken.

Using the same pan on low heat, add low fat milk, light cream cheese, low fat cheddar, dijon mustard, smoked paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, black pepper, chilli powder, and chopped parsley. Stir continuously until the sauce is smooth, melted, and creamy.

Add the cooked macaroni to the sauce and gently fold until evenly combined and creamy. Divide the mac and cheese with the crispy Nashville chicken into 5 portions - your high protein meals are ready to ENJOY!

title: Cajun Honey Butter Chicken & Creamy Potatoes
ingredients: Extra Seasoning: Garlic Powder, Onion Powder, Paprika, Oregano
instructions: Slice the chicken breasts into cubes and place in a mixing bowl. Season with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, oregano, chilli flakes, and a drizzle of olive oil. Mix well until fully coated and the colour deepens, then set aside to marinate.

Cut the uncooked potatoes into small cubes and place in a separate bowl. Season with garlic powder, Italian herbs, paprika, and olive oil. Mix thoroughly, then lay them flat on a lined sheet pan. Oven bake or air fry at 200°C (400°F) for 20-22 minutes until golden and crispy.

While the potatoes cook, heat a pan on medium, melt a little butter, and cook the seasoned chicken for 6-8 minutes until golden. Lower the heat, then add extra butter, this seasoning mix (garlic & onion powder, paprika, oregano), a drizzle of honey, and fresh parsley. Mix well until fully glazed and juicy, then set aside. Repeat if needed for remaining chicken.

In the same pan, add chopped onion and cook for 5 minutes until soft. Stir in tomato paste and cook for another 2 minutes until fragrant. Lower the heat, then pour in evaporated milk and add garlic & herb cream cheese. Stir continuously until the sauce is smooth and slightly thickened.

Once the potatoes are cooked, fold them into the creamy sauce gently until fully coated and indulgent. Divide the creamy potatoes and honey butter chicken into 5 even portions - your high-protein meals are ready to ENJOY!

title: Street Corn Chicken Bowls
ingredients: 1000g (35oz) Raw Chicken Breast, cut into cubes
50g (1.7oz) Cholula Hot Sauce, or hot sauce of choice
50g (1.7oz) Jalapeños, de seeded and finely chopped
Optional Squeeze of Lime (didn't add it as the other components already have lime juice)
instructions: Slice the chicken breasts into cubes and place them in a mixing bowl. Season with salt, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, cumin, parsley, olive oil, and a good squeeze of lime juice. Toss until evenly coated and set aside to marinate while you prep the rice.

In a pot, add water using a 1:2 rice-to-water ratio. Add the washed uncooked rice, bring to a light boil, then reduce to a simmer for 10–12 minutes or until almost fully cooked. Once slightly underdone, remove from heat, drain any excess water, and cover with a lid to let the rice steam and fluff up. Stir in a big handful of chopped fresh coriander and a pinch of salt. Mix gently to combine.

Heat a pan over medium heat and melt some butter. Add the marinated chicken and cook for 4–5 minutes per side until golden and seared. Lower the heat, then stir in extra butter, minced garlic, and chopped fresh parsley. Toss the chicken to coat it in the buttery, fragrant glaze.

In a large bowl, combine sweetcorn, light mayo, Greek yogurt, chopped and deseeded jalapeños, fresh coriander, Cholula hot sauce, Tajín, lime juice, and crumbled feta. Mix until creamy and well combined. Store in a separate container for best freshness.
Divide the chicken, coriander rice, and creamy corn salad into 5 equal portions. Your high-protein meals are now ready to fuel your week!
macroNote: Let the chicken marinate for at least 20 mins for better flavour. Cook chicken on medium heat for 6-8 mins till golden. Lower the heat when adding minced garlic and parsley. Store the corn salsa in a separate container to make reheating easier.

title: Chilli Lime Chicken Potato Bowls
ingredients: 150g (5.3oz) Red & Green Bell Peppers, finely chopped
instructions: Trim excess fat from the chicken thighs and place them in a large mixing bowl. Season with salt, black pepper, lots of minced garlic, chilli flakes, smoked paprika, a drizzle of honey, lime zest and juice, and a splash of light soy sauce. Mix thoroughly with your hands until well coated and the colour deepens. Set aside to marinate.

Slice the uncooked potatoes into small cubes and place on a lined sheet pan. Season with black pepper, smoked paprika, cumin, parsley, garlic powder, shredded coconut, and olive oil. Toss well until evenly coated, then spread out on the tray. Oven bake or air fry at 200°C / 400°F for 20–24 minutes until golden, crispy, and aromatic. Sprinkle with salt once cooked and set aside.
In a blender, combine Greek yogurt, light mayo, honey, 1 deseeded green chilli, a large handful of fresh coriander, salt, and pepper. Blend until smooth, then bottle and refrigerate.

In a large bowl, add finely chopped cucumber (deseeded), red onion, ripe mango, red and green bell peppers, and fresh coriander. Mix until well combined. Optionally, sprinkle chilli flakes or Tajín seasoning. Store in a separate container and refrigerate.
Spread the marinated chicken thighs evenly on a lined sheet pan. Oven bake or air fry at 200°C / 400°F for 20–22 minutes until juicy and lightly charred.
Let the chicken rest for 5 minutes before slicing into cubes. Distribute the chicken, potatoes, sauce, and salad into 5 portions - and your high protein meals are ready for the week!
macroNote: Marinate for as long as you can. Spread evenly on a lined sheet pan, make sure it fills the pan well. Store the mango salsa in a separate container to make reheating easier.

title: Creamy Garlic Butter Steak Bites
ingredients: 1000g (35oz) Raw Top Sirloin Steaks, cut into 1 inch cubes
250g (8.8oz) Low Fat Milk or Light Evaporated Milk
instructions: Slice the beef steaks into 1-inch cubes and place them in a mixing bowl. Season with salt, black pepper, Italian herbs, garlic powder, paprika, and a drizzle of olive oil. Mix thoroughly with your hands until evenly coated, then set aside to marinate.

In a large pan over low heat, melt a little butter or spray lightly with oil. Add chopped sun-dried tomatoes and a sprinkle of Italian herbs. Sauté for 2 minutes until fragrant. Add the cooked white rice and mix well until everything is incorporated. Remove from heat, stir in plenty of grated parmesan and freshly chopped parsley, then fluff until rich, cheesy, and aromatic.

Heat a separate large pan over medium heat and melt a little butter. Add the marinated steak bites and sear for 3–4 minutes on each side until browned and juicy. Reduce the heat, then add a bit more butter, minced garlic, and chopped parsley. Toss until the beef is coated in the garlicky butter glaze. Cook in batches if needed to avoid overcrowding.

Using the same pan on low heat, add low-fat milk, light cream cheese, paprika, and mixed herbs. Stir continuously until the cream cheese is fully melted and the sauce is smooth. Let it bubble gently to thicken to your desired consistency. Store separately for the best texture and taste when reheating.
Distribute the Tuscan-style rice and steak bites evenly into 5 meal prep containers. Your high-protein meals are now ready to enjoy throughout the week!

title: Korean BBQ Chicken Mac n Cheese
ingredients: 1000g (35oz) Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, fat trimmed
1.5 Tsp Red Pepper Flakes or Chilli Flakes
instructions: Trim excess fat from the boneless chicken thighs and place them in a large mixing bowl. Season with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, red pepper flakes, and olive oil. Mix until evenly coated, then set aside to marinate.
Bring a pot of water to a boil. Add macaroni or your preferred pasta and cook for 8-10 minutes until al dente. Drain and set aside.

In a mixing bowl, combine thinly sliced cucumbers, red onion, green onion, red pepper flakes, garlic powder, sesame seeds, gochujang sauce, light soy sauce, and rice vinegar. Mix thoroughly, then store in a separate container and refrigerate.
Heat a pan over medium-high heat and melt a little butter. Cook the marinated chicken thighs for 4-5 minutes on each side until golden and crispy. Remove from the pan and set aside.

In the same pan over low heat, add minced garlic, gochujang hot sauce, a drizzle of honey, and rice vinegar. Stir to form a rich, vibrant glaze. Add the chicken back to the pan and coat evenly until glossy and golden. Remove from heat and set aside.

In the same pan over medium-low heat, add milk, cream cheese, salt, black pepper, paprika, and a pinch of nutmeg. Stir until smooth, then add low-fat cheddar and mix until melted. Add the cooked macaroni and stir until fully coated and creamy.
Slice the glazed Korean chicken into bite-sized cubes. Distribute evenly across 5 servings along with the mac & cheese and cucumber gochujang salad. Your high-protein meals are ready to ENJOY!

title: Korean BBQ Beef Bowls
instructions: In a bowl, combine light and dark soy sauce, garlic and ginger paste, gochujang, honey, oyster sauce, rice vinegar, and sesame seeds. Mix until fully combined, then set aside.

Heat a pan on medium, melt some butter, and cook chopped onions for 5 minutes until soft. Increase heat to high, add lean ground beef, and cook for 8 minutes until browned, using a spatula to break it up.
Lower the heat to medium, pour in the prepared sauce, and cook for 4-5 minutes until the beef turns golden and slightly caramelised. Finish with chopped green onion and sesame seeds, then set aside.
For the Korean spicy sauce, mix low-fat yogurt, gochujang, and honey in a bowl. Add a splash of milk to loosen the consistency if needed. Bottle and store for future use.

In a large bowl, combine thinly sliced cucumber, grated carrots, red onion, green onion, light soy sauce, sriracha, rice vinegar, and garlic powder. Toss gently until evenly coated. Store separately to keep fresh and make reheating easier.
Serve and divide the Korean beef, white rice, crunchy slaw, and spicy sauce into 5 portions. Your high-protein Korean-style meals are ready to ENJOY!

title: Honey Chilli Crisp Chicken Bowl
ingredients: 30-40g (1.4oz) Chilli Crisp Oil drain the extra oil (Brand: Lee Kum Kee)
instructions: Trim any excess fat from the boneless chicken thighs and place them in a mixing bowl. Season with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, paprika, chilli crisp, and a drizzle of honey. Mix well with your hands until the colour deepens and the chicken is fully coated. Set aside to marinate.

In a large bowl, combine diced pineapple (fresh or canned), cucumber, red onion, red bell pepper, avocado, and plenty of chopped coriander. Season with salt, black pepper, and a squeeze of fresh lime juice. Mix gently until well combined. Transfer to a separate container and refrigerate to keep it fresh and crisp for the week.

Add washed uncooked basmati rice to a pot of water (use your preferred rice-to-water ratio). Bring to a boil, then reduce to a simmer for 8-10 minutes or until the rice is cooked through and fluffy. Once cooked, stir in freshly chopped coriander, dried oregano, and a few cracks of chilli garlic salt. Mix gently and set aside.
Spread the marinated chicken thighs evenly on a lined sheet pan. Oven bake or air fry at 190°C / 385°F for 16-18 minutes until golden brown and juicy.

Let the chicken rest for 5 minutes, then slice into juicy cubes. Toss the pieces back onto the tray to soak up all those resting juices. Serve with the herby seasoned rice and the vibrant pineapple avocado salsa. Enjoy your flavour packed, high protein meals!
macroNote: Spread evenly on a lined sheet pan, oven bake or air fry for 16-18 mins at 190C/ 385F until golden brown and juicy. Once cooked, rest for 5 mins then slice into delicious cubes and mix in all the resting juices. Mix thoroughly till well combined then store in separate containers and refrigerate. Makes reheating the chicken and rice easier and keeps salsa fresh

title: Turkish Garlic Beef Pasta
ingredients: Avocado Oil Cooking Spray (or any of choice)
Add extra tomato paste if needed
instructions: In a large bowl, combine a generous amount of thick yogurt (I used Skyr for its high protein content), minced garlic, dried or fresh mint, a pinch of salt, and a good squeeze of lemon juice. Stir until smooth and creamy. Transfer to a separate container and refrigerate to keep it fresh for the week.

Bring a pot of water to a boil. Add your pasta of choice (I used a mix of conchiglie and fusilli) and cook for about 8 minutes or until al dente. Reserve some of the pasta water, drain the rest, and set the pasta aside.

Heat a pan over medium heat and add avocado oil spray. Sauté chopped onions for 8–10 minutes until soft and golden brown. Then add salt, black pepper, paprika, cumin, minced garlic, and tomato paste. Cook for another 3-4 minutes until fragrant and well combined.

Increase the heat to high, add the lean ground beef to the pan, and use a spatula to break it up. Cook for about 8 minutes until browned and fully cooked through. Season again to taste with salt, pepper, and spices. Mix well until juicy and flavourful, then set aside.

In a small pan over low heat, melt a little light butter. Add paprika, chilli flakes, tomato paste, a pinch of salt, and a splash of the reserved pasta water. Stir until smooth and let it simmer gently until rich and glossy.

Divide the pasta and juicy beef into 5 equal portions. Top each with a few spoonfuls of the garlic mint yogurt and a drizzle of the chilli butter sauce. Garnish with chopped cherry tomatoes, fresh mint and chilli garlic seasoning. Your delicious high protein meals are ready to ENJOY!
macroNote: Pan on medium heat, cooking spray, cook chopped onion 8-10mins till golden and soft. Add initial seasoning mix with garlic and tomato paste. Cook for 3-4 mins till fragrant. Add lean ground beef, increase heat to high. Use spatula to break up the meat, cooking spray 8 mins or till fully brown. Add extra seasoning to taste. Once pasta is cooked, reserve some pasta water to use for later. Make this sauce ahead if time, store separately to keep fresh and unspoiled

title: Bang Bang Chicken Rice Bowls
ingredients: 1000g (35oz) Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, cubed
260g (9.1oz) Uncooked White Rice (freshly cooked or leftover cooked)
Extra Seasoning: 1 Tsp each Salt, Oregano, Parsley, Chilli Flakes
instructions: Slice the boneless, skinless chicken thighs into bite-sized cubes. Place them in a large bowl and season with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, ginger powder, and olive oil. Mix thoroughly until the chicken is evenly coated and the colour deepens. Set aside to marinate.

To make the bang bang sauce, combine light mayo, yogurt, sweet chilli sauce, sriracha, rice vinegar, and freshly chopped parsley in a bowl. Mix until smooth. Separate a small amount of this sauce into another bowl—this will be used to baste the chicken during cooking.

Spread the marinated chicken cubes in a single layer on a lined sheet pan. Use a brush to lightly coat each piece with the reserved bang bang sauce. Bake or air fry at 200°C (400°F) for 22–25 minutes until golden and slightly crispy. Once cooked, while the chicken is still hot, brush over a final layer of bang bang sauce to create a glossy, flavour-packed glaze.

In a large pan over medium heat, melt a knob of butter. Add chopped garlic and onion, and sauté for 5 minutes until soft and fragrant. Add salt, oregano, parsley, chilli flakes, and shredded coconut. Stir well and cook for another 3 minutes to toast the coconut slightly. Add your cooked rice, mix thoroughly, then finish with lemon zest and a squeeze of lemon juice. Stir until the rice is fluffy and aromatic.
Serve and divide the bang bang chicken and fragrant coconut rice evenly into 5 portions. Your high-protein meals for the week are ready to ENJOY!

title: Orange Pepper Chicken Rice Bowls
ingredients: 1100g (39oz) Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, trim any excess fat
1 Large Orange Juiced + Orange Zest. I like to add bits of the pulp in the marinade for extra caramelized texture
instructions: Trim any excess fat from the chicken thighs, then place them in a large mixing bowl. Season with salt, black pepper, and garlic powder, then add a drizzle of honey, sriracha, fresh orange juice, orange zest (add extra orange pulp for more texture when cooking), and light soy sauce. Mix thoroughly until fully combined and the colour changes. Set aside to marinate for at least 30 minutes.

Slice all the vegetables for the crunchy cucumber salad. In a large bowl or dish, add thinly sliced cucumbers, red onion, grated carrots, chopped red bell pepper, green onion/scallion, and sesame seeds, followed by a drizzle of honey and rice vinegar. Mix thoroughly until well combined, then store in separate containers and refrigerate to keep fresh and crisp for the week.

Bring a pot of salted water to a boil. Add the uncooked basmati rice (rinsed and drained beforehand) and cook for 8-10 minutes, until tender and fluffy. Drain any excess water and set aside. At the same time, line a sheet pan with parchment paper and spread the marinated chicken evenly in a single layer. Sprinkle a little extra garlic powder and black pepper over the top, then add additional orange juice and orange zest. This will help create a sticky, caramelized glaze as it cooks. Air fry or oven bake for 25-27 minutes at 200C / 400F, until golden brown and sizzling.

While the chicken cooks, heat a large pan over medium–low heat and melt light butter. Add plenty of chopped garlic and cook for about 4 minutes, until fragrant and infused into the butter. Add the leftover cooked rice, mix well, and allow it to heat through. Let the rice cool slightly before adding freshly chopped parsley, a pinch of salt, and chilli flakes. Mix until fluffy.

Once the chicken is cooked, slice it into juicy cubes, mixing it with the resting juices in the sheet pan for extra flavour. Serve and portion with the fluffy garlic rice and crunchy cucumber salad, then ENJOY!
macroNote: Aim for at least 30 minutes of marinating, but longer (up to a few hours in the fridge) will deepen the sweet spicy citrus flavour and help keep the chicken juicy and tender. Spread evenly on a lined sheet pan, squeeze extra orange juice and zest. This will caramelize while cooking and create a sticky glaze. To achieve a good crust, you can broil for 2-3 mins at the end. When making the garlic butter rice, keep the heat medium low and cook the garlic gently. If it browns too much, it will turn bitter and overpower the dish. Keep the salad in separate meal prep containers and combine right before eating to maintain crunch. The vinegar base helps preserve the texture for 2-3 days. Let the rice cool slightly before folding in the herbs to keep them vibrant and fresh. You could also top each container with a sprinkle of fresh herbs right before serving to brighten it up. When you slice the chicken and mix it back through the juices on the sheet pan, you're essentially making a quick pan sauce. Don't skip this step - it adds moisture and boosts that orange honey sriracha flavour.

title: Middle Eastern Honey Garlic Chicken Bowls
ingredients: 250g Uncooked Basmati Rice (cook in advance) (8.8oz / ~1.5 cups uncooked)
Few Cinnamon Sticks or cinnamon powder
instructions: Trim any excess fat from the boneless chicken thighs, then slice into cubes and place in a mixing bowl. Season with salt, black pepper, paprika, garlic powder, onion powder, cinnamon, and coriander powder, then add a drizzle of olive oil, yogurt, and honey. Mix until fully coated and the colour deepens, then set aside to marinate.
In a large mixing bowl, add sliced red onion, plenty of freshly chopped parsley, sumac, a pinch of salt, and a squeeze of lemon juice. Mix well, then store in a separate container and refrigerate.

Rinse the uncooked basmati rice, then place it in a pot of water and bring to a boil. Reduce to a medium low simmer and cook until fully tender and fluffy. Meanwhile, line a sheet pan with parchment paper and spread the marinated chicken in a single, even layer. Oven bake or air fry for 25 minutes, until golden orange with crispy edges.

In a large pan over low heat, melt butter, then add a few cinnamon sticks. Cook for 2-3 minutes, until fragrant, before adding the cooked basmati rice, along with turmeric, salt, paprika, and freshly chopped parsley. Mix until every grain is golden yellow, fluffy, and aromatic.
Serve the crispy, juicy honey garlic chicken with the pickled red onions, then ENJOY!
macroNote: Marinate the chicken for longer if possible. The yogurt, spices, and honey help tenderise the meat and deepen the flavour. Infuse the butter properly with cinnamon sticks over low heat. Rushing this step reduces aroma and depth of flavour in the rice. Rest the chicken briefly before serving, then mix with any tray juices for extra flavour and moisture.

title: Creamy Honey Butter Steak & Potatoes
ingredients: 1000g (35.2oz) Raw Sirloin or Top Sirloin Steaks, cut into cubes
3 Tsp Olive Oil or Cooking Spray
120g (4.2oz) Sun-dried Tomatoes, oil drained and chopped
instructions: Slice the sirloin steaks into 1-inch cubes and place them in a mixing bowl. Season generously with salt, black pepper, parsley, chilli flakes, paprika, and garlic powder, then drizzle with olive oil. Mix well until fully coated and the colour deepens.

Slice the potatoes into small cubes. Place them in a large tray and season with salt, paprika, mixed herbs, and garlic powder, followed by a drizzle of olive oil. Mix until well coated, then spread them in an even layer on a lined sheet pan. Oven bake or air fry for 20 minutes at 200°C / 400°F, until golden yellow and crispy.

Heat a pan over medium heat and melt butter. Cook the steak bites for 3-4 minutes per side, until perfectly seared. Lower the heat, then add extra butter, a drizzle of honey, and fresh parsley. Mix until all steak pieces are coated in this rich honey butter glaze, then set aside. Repeat with the remaining steak bites.

In the same pan over low heat, add the chopped sun-dried tomatoes, along with salt and mixed herbs. Cook for about 2 minutes, then add evaporated milk, light cream cheese, Dijon mustard, and freshly chopped parsley. Stir continuously until the sauce becomes smooth, rich, and creamy.
Keeping the heat on low, add the crispy potatoes to the pan. Fold gently to coat the potatoes evenly in the creamy sauce. Serve and portion with the honey butter steak bites, then ENJOY!
macroNote: Pat the steak dry before seasoning for a better sear. Moisture on the surface prevents browning and can cause the steak to steam instead of caramelise. Do not overcrowd the pan when searing. Cook the steak bites in batches to maintain high heat and achieve a deep golden crust. Use medium heat for searing, then reduce to low before adding butter, honey, and parsley. This prevents the glaze from burning and helps it thicken into a sticky coating. Keep the heat low when making the sauce. Evaporated milk and cream cheese can split if overheated, so gentle heat ensures a smooth, creamy texture.

title: Creamy Mushroom Steak & Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: 1000g (35.2oz) Raw Sirloin or Topside Beef, cut into 1 inch cubes
1000g (35.2oz) Raw Potatoes, peeled cut into chunks
3-4 Sprigs of Fresh Thyme or Dried Thyme
instructions: Slice the steaks into 1-inch cubes and place them in a mixing bowl. Season generously with salt, black pepper, Italian herbs, garlic powder, parsley, and a drizzle of olive oil. Mix until evenly coated, then set aside to marinate briefly.

Wash and peel the potatoes, then slice them into thick chunks. Place them in a pot of cold water and bring to a boil. Cook for about 20 minutes, or until fork-tender. Drain the water, then cover the pot with a lid and let the potatoes steam for 5 minutes.

Once steamed, use a potato masher to mash the potatoes gently until smooth and free of clumps. While still steaming hot, add a knob of butter, warm milk, and a good pinch of salt. Use a spatula to mix thoroughly until perfectly smooth and fluffy, then set aside.

Line a sheet pan with chopped broccoli florets, red onion, grated Parmesan, Italian herbs, garlic powder, salt, and chilli flakes, then spray with avocado cooking oil. Mix well with your hands until fully coated and spread into an even layer. Oven roast or air fry for 18 minutes at 180°C / 370°F, until golden and crispy.
Heat a pan over medium high heat and spray with cooking oil. Cook the steak bites for 3-4 minutes per side, until seared and golden. Set aside and repeat with the remaining steak.

In the same pan over medium heat, add the sliced brown mushrooms. Cook for about 5 minutes, until softened. Reduce the heat, then add fresh thyme, salt, black pepper, Dijon mustard, light cream cheese, and evaporated milk. Stir continuously with a spatula until melted, smooth, and richly creamy.
Serve the steak bites alongside the mashed potatoes and Parmesan roasted broccoli, then top with the creamy mushroom sauce and ENJOY!
macroNote: Start the potatoes in cold water. This ensures they cook evenly from the inside out and prevents a gluey texture. Always steam the potatoes after draining (5 minutes covered). This removes excess moisture, helping the mash become light and fluffy instead of watery. Mash the potatoes while hot, before they cool. Adding butter and warm milk at this stage allows them to absorb properly for a smooth, creamy consistency. Avoid over-mashing. Overworking potatoes breaks down the starch and can make them gummy; stop once smooth and lump-free. Pat the steak dry before searing for the best crust. Moisture prevents browning and causes the steak to steam. Cook steak bites in batches. Overcrowding the pan drops the temperature and stops proper searing. Lower the heat before adding mustard, cream cheese, and evaporated milk. High heat can cause the sauce to split or become grainy.

title: Crispy Tandoori Chicken & Chips
ingredients: 1100g (39oz) Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, trim excess fat
1100g (39oz) Uncooked White or Yellow Potatoes, cut into fries
instructions: Trim any excess fat from the boneless chicken thighs, then place them in a large mixing bowl. Season with tandoori masala, black pepper, smoked paprika, garlic powder, cumin, and coriander powder, then add olive oil, yogurt, and a squeeze of lemon juice. Mix well until fully combined and the colour deepens. Set aside to marinate - the longer it rests, the more intense the flavour will be.

While the chicken marinates, slice and chop the vegetables for the coleslaw. In a large bowl, add shredded cabbage, grated carrots, sliced red onion, freshly chopped coriander, a pinch of salt and pepper, yogurt, light mayo, a drizzle of honey, and a squeeze of lemon juice. Mix thoroughly until creamy and fully combined, then store in separate containers and refrigerate for the week.

Line a sheet pan with parchment paper. Spread the marinated chicken thighs in a single layer and sprinkle a little extra tandoori seasoning on top. Oven bake or air fry for 20-25 minutes, until cooked through, golden, crispy and absolutely delicious.
While the chicken cooks, slice the washed potatoes into fries. Season with black pepper and garlic powder, then spray with cooking oil (such as avocado oil spray). Mix until well coated.
Once the chicken is cooked, set it aside to rest. Then oven bake or air fry the fries for 22-27 minutes at 200C / 400F, until golden and crispy. Once cooked, sprinkle salt over them to taste.

Slice the tandoori chicken into juicy cubes, making sure to mix it with the resting juices left in the sheet pan for extra flavour. Serve and portion with the crispy fries and creamy coleslaw, then ENJOY!
macroNote: The yogurt, lemon juice, and spices in the marinade help tenderise the chicken and infuse flavour. For the best results, marinate for at least 1 hour, or overnight if possible. Make sure the chicken thighs are not overlapping. Air circulation is key for crispy edges and caramelisation. Once cooked, rest the chicken for 5 minutes before slicing into cubes. Make sure to mix with all the resting juices from the pan - no flavour gets wasted! Add salt to the fries after cooking. Sprinkling salt later helps prevent excess moisture release during cooking, keeping them crisp. Make the salad in batches and store it separately in the fridge to keep it fresh and crisp throughout the week. Use salt lightly in the coleslaw to prevent it becoming watery. When reheating, reheat the chicken and fries in the air fryer for 5 minutes at 190°C for the best texture.

title: Chicken Fajita Mac n Cheese
ingredients: 1 Tsp each: Salt, Oregano, Garlic Powder, Onion Powder, Paprika, Chilli Powder, Cumin
240g (8.5oz) Uncooked Macaroni Pasta (or pasta of choice)
instructions: First slice your chicken breasts into cubes, then add 1.5 serving fajita spice mix with olive oil and lime juice. Mix till you lose patience then set the chicken aside to marinate!

Now cook your pasta. Fill a pot with water, bring to a boil then add the macaroni pasta and boil for 8 mins till aldente then drain and set aside. While the pasta is cooking get a pan on medium heat, melt down butter then cook the chicken for 3-4 mins each side till golden brown then set aside. Repeat till all the chicken is cooked.
In the same pan in the remaining butter on medium heat add your chopped onions and bell peppers with ½ serving fajita spice mix. Give it a good mix in then cook for 5 mins till soft and fragrant.
Then lower the heat completely and add the milk, cream cheese, grated cheddar and shredded mozzarella. Mix till the cheese melts and the sauce is cheesy and creamy.

Now add the cooked macaroni in the creamy sauce, give it a good mix till well incorporated, add the cooked chicken with a squeeze of lime juice. Give it one final mix then distribute evenly into 4 servings and your high protein meal are ready to ENJOY!
macroNote: Cook onions and peppers on medium heat for at least 5 minutes until soft and fragrant. Keep heat on low when adding milk and cream cheese to prevent the sauce from splitting. Reheat in a microwave or pan on low heat for 5 minutes. Add a splash of milk to loosen and restore creaminess.

title: Chicken Shawarma Loaded Fries
ingredients: 1 Tsp each: Salt, Black Pepper, Cumin, Turmeric, Paprika
100g (3.5oz) Low Fat Sour Cream or Yogurt
900g (32oz) Raw Potatoes, thinly sliced into fries
1 Tsp each Salt, Black Pepper, Paprika, Cumin
instructions: Slice the chicken breasts into thin strips and place them in a bowl. Add olive oil, minced garlic, 1.5 servings of shawarma spice mix, and a squeeze of lemon juice. Mix thoroughly until well coated—if the color isn't vibrant, add more seasoning. Let marinate while prepping the fries.

Slice the potatoes into thin fries and season with salt, pepper, paprika, cumin, and olive oil. Toss until evenly coated, then spread on a lined baking tray (use baking paper). Bake or air fry at 200°C/400°F for 20 minutes, flipping halfway, until golden and crispy.

Place the marinated chicken on a separate lined baking tray. Bake or air fry at 200°C/400°F for 15 minutes, until golden brown with slightly charred edges. If possible, cook the chicken and fries at the same time to save time, or cook separately if needed.

While the chicken and fries cook, prepare the white sauce. In a bowl, whisk together sour cream, mayo, minced garlic, black pepper, and a squeeze of lemon juice until smooth. Transfer to a bottle and refrigerate for meal prep use.
To assemble, layer the shawarma-spiced chicken over the crispy fries. Top with pickled red onions, crumbled feta cheese, and a generous drizzle of white sauce. Serve and ENJOY!
macroNote: Pan-fry the chicken in light butter or air fry—both methods offer great results. Make the white sauce in bulk and store it in the fridge for other meals. Serve the white sauce, pickled onions, and feta cheese fresh when ready to eat.

title: Chicken Shawarma Rice Bowls
ingredients: Season to taste: Salt, Garlic Powder, Cumin
30g (1.1oz) Buffalo Hot Sauce (or any hot sauce)
½ Tsp each: Salt, Black Pepper, Garlic Powder, Onion Powder, Paprika
instructions: Butterfly slice the chicken breasts into thinner fillet halves. Season both sides with salt, black pepper, onion powder, parsley, smoked paprika, cumin, minced garlic, and lemon juice. Rub the spices in thoroughly, ensuring even coverage, then set aside to marinate.

For the golden rice, heat a pot over medium heat and melt butter. Add the spice blend (turmeric, paprika, salt, cumin) and toast for 1–2 minutes until fragrant. Stir in the washed basmati rice, mixing until each grain is coated in the spices. Pour in 400g water (double the rice weight), bring to a light boil, then reduce the heat to low. Cover and simmer for 7–8 minutes until fully cooked and fluffy. Drain any excess water and set aside.

While the rice cooks, prepare the samurai sauce and cucumber salad. Samurai Sauce: In a bowl, whisk together yogurt, mayo, hot sauce, lemon juice, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, and paprika until smooth. Store in a squeeze bottle for easy use. Cucumber Salad: In another bowl, combine yogurt, chopped cucumbers, tomatoes, and fresh parsley. Season with salt, garlic powder, and cumin to taste. Mix well and store separately for easier reheating.

Heat a pan over medium heat and melt butter. Cook the chicken fillets for 3–4 minutes per side, ensuring a golden-brown crust without burning the spices. Set aside to rest and repeat until all chicken is cooked.
Once everything is ready, slice the chicken into bite-sized cubes. Serve with golden rice, cucumber salad, and a generous drizzle of samurai sauce. Garnish with fresh parsley and ENJOY!
macroNote: Cook chicken over medium heat to prevent spices burning and develop a golden brown crust. Prepare the samurai sauce and cucumber salad in bulk and store separately. Serve fresh when ready to eat. Reheat chicken and rice in a pan on low heat, covered, for 5 minutes.

title: Honey Buffalo Chicken Rice Bowls
ingredients: ½ Tsp each: Garlic Powder, Smoked Paprika, Black Pepper
200g Uncooked Basmati Rice/Approx 135g Cooked Rice per serving
instructions: Slice the chicken breasts into cubes and place them in a bowl. Add minced garlic, black pepper, onion powder, paprika, salt, and olive oil. Toss until evenly coated, then set aside to marinate.

Prepare the honey buffalo sauce by blending mayo, buffalo hot sauce, honey, lemon juice, garlic powder, paprika, and black pepper until smooth and creamy. Transfer to a bottle for easy use throughout the week. (Tip: Start cooking the white rice now so it's ready by the time everything else is done)

For the crunchy slaw, combine thinly sliced red cabbage, grated carrots, chopped green onion, and fresh cilantro in a bowl. Add mayo, honey, salt, and black pepper, then toss until well incorporated. Store separately for easier reheating.

Heat a pan over medium-high heat and melt butter. Add the marinated chicken and cook for 4 minutes per side until golden brown and crispy. Lower the heat, then drizzle in honey and buffalo sauce, stirring until the chicken is well coated and the sauce thickens slightly. Set aside and repeat for any remaining chicken.
Assemble the meal by serving the hot rice with crispy honey buffalo chicken and crunchy slaw on the side. Drizzle with extra sauce, garnish with fresh cilantro, and ENJOY!
macroNote: Lower the heat before adding honey and buffalo sauce. Let it simmer for 1–2 minutes until the glaze thickens. Store the sauce and crunchy slaw separately from the chicken for easier reheating. Serve fresh when ready to eat.

title: Creamy Tuscan Chicken
ingredients: 210g Uncooked Basmati/Approx 140g Cooked Rice per serving
Sprinkle Mixed Herbs and Salt to taste
instructions: Slice the chicken breasts into cubes and place them in a bowl. Add minced garlic, dried basil, chili flakes, salt, smoked paprika, and a drizzle of olive oil. Toss until well coated, then set aside to marinate.

For the creamy sauce, blend milk, cream cheese, grated Parmesan, tomato paste, dried basil, and salt to taste until completely smooth. Set aside. (Tip: Start cooking the rice now so it's ready when serving the creamy chicken)

Heat a pan over medium-high heat and add a little olive oil or butter. Cook the chicken for 4 minutes on one side, then flip. Lower the heat and pour in the creamy sauce, followed by cherry tomatoes and spinach. Stir lightly, cover with a lid, and let it simmer on low heat for 5–7 minutes.

Remove the lid halfway through and stir gently to prevent sticking while allowing the sauce to thicken. By now, the chicken will be coated in the creamy sauce, the spinach will have wilted, and the cherry tomatoes will be soft and bursting with flavor.
Serve the creamy chicken over hot herb-seasoned rice, distribute evenly, and ENJOY!
macroNote: Lower the heat after cooking the chicken for 4 minutes before adding the creamy sauce to prevent splitting. Cook rice in advance so it's ready to serve with the chicken and sauce.

title: Korean Beef Rice Bowls
ingredients: 210g (7.4oz) Uncooked Short Grain or Basmati Rice/Approx 140g Cooked Rice per serving
instructions: In a bowl, combine dark soy sauce, light soy sauce, honey, minced garlic, gochujang paste, and sesame seeds. Whisk until well mixed and set aside. (Tip: Start cooking the rice now so it's ready when serving)

Heat a pan over high heat and melt butter. Add the ground beef and cook for 6–8 minutes, using a spatula to break it up as it browns. Once fully cooked, pour in the prepared sauce along with chopped green onion. Stir and cook for another 5 minutes until well combined, golden brown, and slightly crispy. Remove from heat.

For the quick pickled cucumber slaw, combine sliced cucumber, grated carrot, soy sauce, rice vinegar, garlic powder, chili flakes, and sesame seeds in a large bowl. Mix well with a spoon, then store separately to keep the texture fresh.
To make the spicy mayo, whisk together mayo, sriracha, garlic powder, and lemon juice until smooth. Transfer to a squeeze bottle for easy use throughout the week.

Assemble the meal by serving the flavorful beef with the hot rice, adding a side of pickled cucumber slaw and a generous drizzle of spicy sauce. Garnish with extra green onion and sesame seeds, then ENJOY!
macroNote: Store pickled cucumbers separately and keep the sauce in a squeezy bottle for easier reheating. Serve when ready to eat. Reheat beef and rice in a pan or pot on low heat, covered, for 5 minutes. Add a splash of water if it's too dry.

title: Creamy Butter Chicken Pasta
ingredients: 270g Uncooked Penne Pasta (Or use protein pasta)
Spice Mix: ½ Tsp each Smoked Paprika, Turmeric, Garam Masala, Chilli Powder, Salt, Black Pepper
instructions: Slice the chicken breasts into cubes and place them in a bowl. Add minced garlic, smoked paprika, turmeric, garam masala, chili powder, salt, black pepper, yogurt, and lemon juice. Mix until evenly coated, then set aside to marinate.

Heat a pan over medium heat and melt butter. Add thinly sliced onion and cook for 5 minutes until soft and fragrant. Stir in the spice mix, ensuring the onions are well coated, then add canned chopped tomatoes and cashew nuts.

Mix well and let everything cook for another 5 minutes on medium-low heat. Turn off the heat and stir in yogurt, then let the mixture cool for 5 minutes. (Tip: Transfer to a large dish for faster cooling)
While the sauce cools, bring a pot of water to a boil and cook the penne pasta for 7–8 minutes until al dente. Once cooked, reserve 1 cup of pasta water, then drain the rest.
Transfer the cooled sauce to a blender, add ½ cup of pasta water, and blend for 2–3 minutes until completely smooth and creamy.

Reheat the pan over medium-high heat, melt butter, and cook the marinated chicken for 4 minutes per side until golden brown. Lower the heat, then pour in the butter chicken sauce and add the cooked pasta. Stir until well combined and heated through.
Garnish with fresh coriander and white sauce, then evenly portion, serve and ENJOY!
macroNote: Marinate the chicken overnight for the best flavor, but 10–15 minutes works if short on time. Use fresh tomatoes instead of canned to reduce acidity and add natural sweetness. Let the sauce cool before blending to prevent pressure buildup and spills. Turn off the heat before adding yogurt to keep the sauce smooth and prevent curdling.

title: Crispy Potatoes & Creamy Eggs
instructions: Cut the potatoes into small cubes and season with oregano, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper. Toss until evenly coated, then spread them on a plate and microwave for 5 minutes until soft and fork-tender.
Heat a pan over medium heat and add olive oil. Cook the microwaved potatoes for 4 minutes to crisp them up slightly, then add paprika, chopped red onion, red bell pepper, and chopped turkey bacon.
Stir everything together until the potatoes are well mixed with the vegetables and turkey bacon. Cook for another 5 minutes until golden brown and crispy, then set aside.

In the same pan over low heat, pour in the whisked eggs. Stir gently with a spatula for 4–5 minutes, scrambling them slowly. Just before they fully cook, add cream cheese and fold it in gently until melted, creating a fluffy, creamy texture.
Serve the creamy scrambled eggs alongside the crispy potato mix, drizzle with spicy mayo, garnish with fresh parsley, and ENJOY!
macroNote: Microwave potatoes in batches for 4–5 minutes, laying them flat for even softening and quicker cooking. Crisp up potatoes in the pan for 4–5 minutes on medium-high heat before adding other ingredients. Add cooking spray or olive oil if needed. Cook eggs on medium-low heat for a soft, fluffy texture. Stir in cream cheese until fully melted and combined.

title: Creamy Garlic Beef Pasta
ingredients: 250g Uncooked Fusilli Pasta (or pasta of choice)
instructions: Chop the garlic cloves, red bell pepper, and tomatoes. Heat a pan over medium heat, add olive oil, and sauté the garlic for 2 minutes until fragrant. Then, add the chopped bell peppers and tomatoes.
Season with Italian herbs, paprika, salt, and black pepper, then cook for 5 minutes until soft and fragrant. Transfer the mixture to a dish and let it cool while preparing the next step.
Bring a pot of salted water to a boil. Add the fusilli pasta and cook for 8 minutes until al dente. Reserve ½ cup of pasta water, then drain the rest and set the pasta aside.
In a blender cup, combine the cooled vegetable mixture, cream cheese, and reserved pasta water. Blend for 2 minutes until completely smooth and creamy. The sauce should be a vibrant orange color.

Return the pan to high heat, add a drizzle of olive oil, and cook the ground beef with extra seasoning (Italian herbs, paprika, salt, black pepper) for 6–8 minutes. Use a spatula to break up the meat while cooking until fully browned with no pink bits remaining.

Lower the heat and pour the creamy sauce over the beef, followed by the cooked pasta. Stir gently until well combined and indulgent. Let it simmer on low heat for 3–4 minutes until the sauce thickens slightly.
Garnish with fresh parsley and parmesan, then serve and distribute evenly. ENJOY!
macroNote: Let the tomato mixture cool completely before blending to prevent pressure buildup and spills. After combining pasta and sauce, let it simmer for 3–4 minutes to thicken and coat the pasta. Freeze for later and reheat on low heat for 5 minutes. Add a splash of milk, cover, and heat until creamy again.

title: Chicken Fajita Rice
ingredients: 1 Tsp each: Salt, Paprika, Cumin, Garlic Powder, Turmeric
instructions: Butterfly slice the chicken breasts into thinner fillets/cutlets. Season both sides evenly with oregano, garlic powder, cumin, smoked paprika, salt, black pepper, and olive oil. Rub the spices into the chicken until fully coated, then set aside.

Thinly slice the onions and bell peppers for later. For the creamy green sauce, blend yogurt, mayo, garlic cloves, fresh coriander, salt, black pepper, and lemon juice until smooth. Adjust seasoning to taste and set aside.
Heat a pan over medium heat and add olive oil. Cook the chicken cutlets for 3–4 minutes per side until golden brown and fully cooked. Set aside and repeat until all the chicken is done.
