In the same pan over medium heat, add the sliced onions and bell peppers. Sauté for 4–5 minutes until soft and fragrant. Stir in the washed uncooked rice along with the spice mix (salt, paprika, cumin, garlic powder, turmeric).
Mix everything well and toast the rice for 2 minutes, then add water or stock. Bring to a gentle simmer, cover, and cook on low heat for 8-10 minutes until the rice is fluffy and fully cooked.
Slice the chicken cutlets into thin strips, then serve over the fajita-seasoned rice. Drizzle generously with the creamy green sauce and ENJOY!
macroNote: Season the chicken thoroughly on both sides to ensure even flavor in every bite. Toast the rice with the veggies and spices for a deeper, more aromatic flavor before adding water. Let the rice come to a gentle boil, then cover and simmer for 8–10 minutes until fully cooked and fluffy.

title: Creamy Spicy Chipotle Chicken Pasta
ingredients: 1.5 tsp each: Salt, Cumin, Smoked Paprika
200g (7oz) Uncooked Penne Pasta (or pasta of choice)
1 Tsp Chipotle Chilli Flakes (omit for less heat)
instructions: Start by slicing the chicken breasts into cubes, then season with chipotle paste, minced garlic, honey, lime juice, salt, cumin and smoked paprika. Mix till the color changes then set aside to marinate.
Now cook your pasta. Get water in a pot, bring to a boil then add your pasta and boil for 8-9 mins till al dente. Once cooked, remove ½ cup pasta water and drain the rest then set aside.
Next for the creamy sauce, in a blender cup add milk, cream cheese, parmesan, chipotle paste, chili flakes, salt, pasta water. Blend till smooth and creamy!
Then get a pan on medium heat, melt down butter and cook the chicken for 8-10 min (4-5 mins each side) till golden brown and charred.

Once the chicken is cooked, lower the heat then add the cooked pasta with the creamy sauce over it and give it all a thorough gentle mix till well incorporated. Let it simmer for 1-2 mins to thicken the sauce then you're ready to serve and distribute evenly, garnish with fresh parsley and ENJOY!
macroNote: Marinate the chicken for at least 30 minutes or overnight for deeper flavor. Swap chipotle paste for other chili pastes or tomato paste if needed. Ensure the sauce isn't too watery before blending; it will thicken when heated in the pan. Store for up to 4 days and reheat in a pan or microwave when ready to eat.

title: Garlic Herb Chicken Rice Bowls
ingredients: 20g (1.5 Tbsp) Garlic Paste or Minced Garlic
1 Tsp Chilli Flakes (omit for milder flavour)
instructions: Place the chicken thighs in a mixing bowl. Add garlic paste, salt, black pepper, mixed herbs, parsley, paprika, chili flakes, and olive oil. Mix thoroughly until well coated, then set aside to marinate.

While the chicken marinates, cook the rice by boiling it in a pot of water for 8–10 minutes. Once done, drain any excess water and set aside. While the rice cooks, chop the garlic, red onion, and bell peppers.
Heat a pan over medium heat, melt butter, and cook the chicken thighs for 5–6 minutes per side until a deep golden crust forms. Once cooked, set aside to rest. Repeat for the rest of the chicken.

In the same pan over medium-low heat, sauté the chopped garlic, onion, and bell peppers for 5–6 minutes until soft and fragrant. Stir in extra seasoning (salt, pepper, mixed herbs, parsley, paprika) till the onions and peppers catch colour.
Add the cooked basmati rice and mix well until every grain is coated in the spices and takes on a vibrant orange color.
Garnish the rice with freshly chopped parsley. Slice the chicken thighs into cubes, serve with the rice, and ENJOY!
macroNote: Marinate the chicken for at least 30 minutes or overnight for the best flavor. Cook the chicken thighs over medium heat with a little butter or cooking spray for 5–6 minutes per side until a deep golden crust forms. Mix the cooked rice thoroughly to ensure every grain is coated in seasoning and vibrant in color. Add extra paprika and salt if needed. Slice the chicken thighs into cubes and serve over the rice. Finish with a squeeze of lemon juice or pair with a sauce of your choice.

title: Teriyaki Beef Fried Rice
ingredients: 20g (1.5 Tbsp) Minced Garlic or Garlic Paste
Dash of Milk for desired consistency
200g Dry Weight / ~520g Cooked White Rice (I use basmati but you can use short grain rice)
instructions: First chop up all your vegetables, this includes green onions, white onion, garlic and coriander/cilantro. And also cook your rice by boiling in a pot or use leftover rice.
Get a pan on high heat, melt down some butter then cook all your ground beef for 6-8 mins till completely brown and no pink bits remain. Use a spatula to break up the meat to cook quicker.
Once cooked lower the heat to medium heat, add lots of minced garlic, soy sauce, honey or maple syrup, rice vinegar, green part of the green onion and sesame seeds.
Mix till well incorporated then cook the beef for another 5 mins till golden brown and slightly crispy. Once cooked set the beef aside.
Now in the same pan add chopped garlic white onion and the white part of green onion. Cook these for 5-6 mins on medium heat till soft and fragrant then push to the side of the pan.
Add in your whisked eggs and use a spatula to keep stirring gently till the eggs are scrambled. Once ready, mix with all the veg.
Now make a well in the middle and add in your cooked rice with more soy sauce, chilli garlic sauce, green onion, coriander and sesame seeds.
Mix everything till well combined and every grain of rice is coloured.
For the Yum Yum sauce, In a bowl combine yogurt, light mayo, ketchup, sriracha, garlic powder and a dash of milk. Mix till smooth then bottle this up!
Finally serve with the beef and the fried rice then ENJOY your high protein meals for the week!
macroNote: Cook the beef on high heat for 6-8 mins to develop a good brown colour. Lower the heat to medium when adding the garlic, soy sauce and maple syrup. Let the beef cook for another 5 mins to get crispy then set aside. Cook the onions and garlic for 5 mins till softened. Push the veg to the side and cook the eggs on low heat till scrambled. When adding the rice and extra soy sauce, give everything a good mix to coat every grain of rice. Add extra soy sauce if needed to darken

title: Garlic Parmesan Steak Alfredo Pasta
ingredients: 30g (2 Tbsp) Garlic Paste or Minced Garlic
1 Tsp each: Salt, Black Pepper, Italian Herbs, Parsley, Smoked Paprika
210g (7.4oz) Uncooked Linguine Pasta (or pasta of choice)
50g (1/4 Cup) Pasta Water (Optional for sauce consistency)
instructions: Slice the beef steaks into bite-sized cubes. Season with salt, black pepper, Italian herbs, parsley, garlic powder, smoked paprika, and olive oil. Mix well until evenly coated.
Bring a pot of water to a boil, then add your pasta of choice. Cook for 8–10 minutes until al dente. Reserve 1/4 cup pasta water, then drain the rest and set aside.
Heat a pan over medium-high heat, add butter, and sear the steak bites for 2 minutes per side until a golden-brown crust forms.

Once cooked, lower the heat and add extra butter, minced garlic, and grated parmesan. Stir until the steak bites are well coated in this flavourful butter, then set aside. Repeat for the remaining steak bites.
In the same pan over low heat, sauté chopped garlic and onion for 5 minutes until soft and fragrant. Stir in the extra seasonings (salt, pepper, Italian herbs, parsley, smoked paprika).
Mix until the spices are well combined, then add evaporated milk, cream cheese, parmesan, and reserved pasta water. Stir gently until smooth and thickened.
Add the cooked pasta into the creamy sauce, stirring until fully combined and coated. Serve with the juicy steak bites, and your high-protein meal prep is ready for the week!
macroNote: Marinate steak bites for at least 30 minutes for deeper flavor. Sear on medium-high heat with butter for 2 minutes per side until a golden crust forms. Add milk and cream cheese on low heat to prevent splitting. Stir until smooth, let it bubble slightly to thicken, then mix in cooked pasta. Freezes well and reheats easily. Warm in a pan or microwave for 5 minutes on low, adding a splash of milk to restore creaminess.

title: Honey BBQ Chicken Mac & Cheese
ingredients: 60g (2.1oz) Buffalo Hot Sauce (or any hot sauce)
instructions: Cut the chicken breast into bite-sized cubes. In a bowl, mix with minced garlic, black pepper, paprika, salt, and olive oil until evenly coated. Adjust seasoning if you need a deeper color.
Meanwhile, cook the macaroni pasta in a pot of water for 8 mins until al dente. Drain and set aside.
Heat a pan over medium-high heat and lightly coat with cooking spray. Sear the chicken cubes for 3–4 minutes per side until they are golden brown and nicely charred.
Turn off the heat completely, then drizzle honey and BBQ sauce over the chicken. Toss well until every piece is coated and juicy, then transfer to a bowl. Repeat for the remaining chicken.
In the same pan over low heat, add milk, hot sauce (such as buffalo sauce), cream cheese, and shredded cheddar cheese. Whisk gently until the mixture is smooth and creamy.
Stir the cooked macaroni into the cheese sauce until thoroughly combined. Garnish with chopped parsley, then serve with the delicious BBQ chicken, divide into 4 equal servings and ENJOY!
macroNote: Cook chicken on medium-high heat for 3–4 minutes per side until golden brown. Turn off the heat before adding honey and BBQ sauce to prevent burning. For the creamy sauce, add all ingredients on low heat and stir gently (preferably with a whisk) until thick and smooth. Store in the fridge for up to 4 days or freeze for later. Reheat in a pan or microwave when ready to eat.

title: Garlic Parm Chicken & Creamy Mashed Potatoes
ingredients: ½ tsp each: Garlic Powder, Italian Herbs, Salt, Paprika
instructions: Slice the chicken breasts into thinner halves. In a bowl, season with garlic powder, Italian herbs, salt, paprika, olive oil, and grated parmesan. Rub in thoroughly to ensure both sides are evenly coated, then set aside to marinate.
Cut the washed potatoes into 1-inch cubes. Place them in a pot of water and boil for 12–14 minutes until fork-tender. Drain the water and allow the remaining steam to evaporate any excess moisture.
Using a potato masher, mash the potatoes until smooth and fluffy. Be careful not to over-mash; you want to maintain a pleasant texture.
Stir in a knob of butter, evaporated milk, garlic powder, salt, and freshly cracked black pepper. Mix until the mash is smooth and well combined.

Heat a pan over medium-low heat and cook the marinated chicken for 4 minutes per side until golden and crispy, forming a flavor-packed crust. Once cooked, set the chicken aside. Repeat for the remaining chicken cutlets.
In the same pan on low heat, add the same spices used for the chicken to toast in the remaining oil. Then, stir in milk, light cream cheese, and parmesan until the sauce is smooth and well blended.

Continue stirring the sauce until it becomes completely smooth and creamy, letting it bubble slightly to thicken. Chop the rested chicken into bite-sized pieces, then serve by layering the creamy mash with the sauce and topping with the chopped chicken. ENJOY!
macroNote: Coat the chicken evenly with seasoning on both sides; add more if needed. Cook on medium-low heat for 3–4 minutes in a non-stick pan (no butter or oil) until a golden crust forms. (Optional) Peel potatoes, boil until fork-tender (12–14 minutes), then drain and mash until smooth. For reheating, warm everything in a pan on low for 5 minutes; store the creamy sauce separately for best results.

title: Chilli Peanut Chicken Noodles
ingredients: 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes (omit for less heat)
instructions: Slice the chicken breasts into cubes. In a bowl, marinate with black pepper, garlic & ginger paste, chilli flakes, onion powder, sriracha, and soy sauce. Mix until the color deepens, then set aside.
While the chicken marinates, cook the noodles for 5–6 minutes (or follow package instructions). Reserve some noodle water, then drain and rinse the noodles under cold water.

Heat a pan over medium heat and add butter. Cook the chicken cubes for 3–4 minutes per side until golden and crispy. Once cooked, add extra butter and chopped coriander, tossing until well coated. Set aside.

In the same pan over low heat, combine peanut butter, soy sauce, sriracha, rice vinegar, optional chilli flakes, and a splash of reserved noodle water. Stir continuously for 3–4 minutes until the sauce is silky smooth.
Toss the cooked noodles in the sauce along with chopped green onions, additional coriander, and sesame seeds. Mix thoroughly, then serve alongside the juicy chicken and ENJOY!
macroNote: Marinate the chicken for at least 30 minutes, or overnight, for deeper flavor. Cook on medium heat for 3–4 minutes per side, avoiding overcrowding for a golden-brown crust. Lower heat before adding butter and coriander. Boil the noodles first, reserving some pasta water for the peanut sauce. Cook noodles on medium heat for 4–5 minutes until al dente, then drain and rinse with cold water to stop cooking. Warm the peanut sauce over low heat until silky smooth—no need to fully cook. For reheating, warm everything on low heat for 5–10 minutes, adding a splash of water if noodles need loosening.

title: Korean BBQ Chicken Rice Bowls
ingredients: 1 Tsp Red Pepper Flakes or Chilli Flakes (Omit for less heat)
200g (7oz) Uncooked Basmati Rice (≈130g or 4.6oz cooked rice per serving)
instructions: Trim any excess fat from your boneless chicken thighs. In a mixing bowl, marinate the chicken with black pepper, garlic & ginger paste, gochujang, sriracha, sesame seeds, and light soy sauce. Mix thoroughly then set aside to marinate.
While the chicken marinates, cook your rice by boiling it or use leftover rice as a time-saving option.

Thinly slice the cucumbers and place them in a bowl. Add salt, minced garlic, gochujang, honey, rice vinegar, sesame seeds, red pepper flakes (optional), and soy sauce. Toss well until evenly combined.
Transfer the cucumber salad to a separate container and refrigerate—it will keep fresh for the week.
Spread the marinated chicken thighs evenly on a lined sheet pan (use baking paper). Oven bake or air fry at 200°C/400°F for 16–18 minutes until the chicken has a beautifully golden char and juicy.
Let the chicken thighs rest for 3–4 minutes, then slice them into bite-sized cubes. Serve with the rice and cucumber salad, and ENJOY!
macroNote: Swap for chicken breast if preferred—slice into thin fillets before marinating. Marinate overnight for the best flavor, but you can cook immediately if needed. Make the cucumber salad in batches and store separately—it gets better over time. Monitor chicken while air frying; if not crowded, it may cook in 12–13 minutes. Aim for a nice char. For reheating, warm the chicken and rice on low heat in a pan; store cucumbers separately and serve cold.

title: Butter Chicken & Crispy Masala Potatoes
ingredients: 800g (28oz) Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, cubed
20g (1.5 Tbsp) Minced Garlic or Garlic Paste
½ Tsp each: Salt, Garam Masala, Paprika, Turmeric
instructions: Trim any excess fat from the chicken thighs and cut into cubes. In a bowl, marinate the chicken with minced garlic, salt, garam masala, paprika, turmeric, chilli powder, yogurt, and lemon juice.
Mix the chicken thoroughly until its color deepens, then set aside. Next, slice the potatoes into small cubes and season with salt, paprika, garam masala, garlic powder, and olive oil.
Mix the potatoes till well coated then place on a sheet pan/tray and oven or air fry for 20-23 mins at 200C/400F till golden and crispy.

Spread the marinated chicken on a separate sheet pan or tray and cook in the oven or air fryer at 200°C/400°F for 18–20 minutes until golden and juicy. (Tip: You can cook the chicken and potatoes simultaneously if your equipment allows)
In a pan over medium heat, melt butter and add sliced onions, salt, garam masala, paprika, and turmeric. Sauté for 5–6 minutes until the onions are soft and fragrant.
Make a well in the center of the pan and add minced garlic, cashew nuts, and the tomatoes (canned or fresh). Stir thoroughly, then cover with a lid and let it simmer on low heat for 6–8 minutes.
Stir the mixture, then allow it to cool before transferring to a blender. Blend for 2–3 minutes until completely smooth.
Return the blended sauce to the pan and add yogurt, evaporated milk, and a few small cubes of butter. Stir gently until the sauce becomes creamy.

Fold in the cooked chicken, mixing thoroughly so each piece is well coated. Finally, distribute the butter chicken with the masala potatoes into 4 portions and drizzle with the white sauce then ENJOY!
macroNote: Use cubed chicken breast as an alternative—marinate for at least 30 minutes or overnight for deeper flavor. Pan-cook the chicken over medium heat for 3–4 minutes per side as another option. Sauté onions in butter for at least 5 minutes until softened, then add garlic and cashews before stirring in the tomatoes. Cover and cook on low heat for 6–8 minutes until the tomatoes break down. Let the sauce cool completely before blending to prevent pressure buildup.

title: Nacho Cheese Beef Loaded Fries
ingredients: 1 Tsp each: Salt, Black Pepper, Garlic Powder, Onion Powder, Paprika, Oregano, Cumin
900g Raw Potatoes, cut into thin fries
instructions: Slice the washed potatoes into thin French fries. Mix with 1 serving of taco spice mix and a drizzle of olive oil until evenly coated.
Arrange the fries on a lined sheet pan and oven bake or air fry at 200°C/400°F for 20–25 minutes until golden and crispy.
Heat a pan over medium-high heat, add butter, and cook all the ground beef for 5–7 minutes, breaking it up with a spatula until browned.

Once the beef is browned, stir in 1 serving of taco spice mix, tomato paste, chopped jalapeños, and jalapeño juice. Cook for 2 more minutes until the mixture is juicy and flavours intensify then set aside.

Using the same pan on low heat, add evaporated milk, American cheese slices, sharp cheddar, and a splash of jalapeño juice. Stir until the cheeses melt and the sauce becomes silky smooth. (This sauce can be stored in a container and refrigerated for later use)

Prepare the side salad by combining chopped tomatoes, red onion, red and green bell peppers, avocado, coriander, lime juice, honey, salt, and black pepper in a bowl. Toss until well combined and store separately.
To serve, distribute the crispy taco fries evenly and top with the juicy jalapeño beef. Drizzle generously with the nacho cheese sauce and serve alongside the fresh salad. ENJOY!
macroNote: Prepare the nacho cheese sauce on low heat, stirring until thick and smooth. Store in a bottle and reheat before use, as it will harden when cooled. Keep the side salad in a separate container—it stays fresh for 4–5 days. For reheating, warm the beef and fries in a pan, or air fry the fries for 4–5 minutes for extra crispiness.

title: Creamy Garlic Herb Cajun Chicken
ingredients: 800g Raw White Potatoes peeled and diced into 1 inch chunks
¾ Tsp Each Salt, Italian Herbs, Chilli Flakes, Garlic, Onion Powder, Parsley, Paprika
instructions: First get your boneless skinless chicken thighs, season with salt, Italian herbs, chilli flakes, parsley, garlic and onion powder, paprika and olive oil. Mix till well coated and combined.
Next peel all your potatoes then slice into chunks. Place them in a pot of cold water then boil for 12-14 mins until fork tender. Drain all the water then cover with a lid for 5 mins to steam.
Uncover then mash the potatoes using a masher or ricer till smooth and fluffy. Note - don't overly mash them!
Next add a knob of room temperature butter with warm milk, salt and garlic powder. Use a spatula to mix everything till smooth and combined.
Now place all your chicken thighs flat and evenly spread on a lined sheet pan. Now oven bake or air fry for 22-25mins at 200C / 400F. The chicken should come out golden and charred!
For the cream sauce get a pan on low heat, melt down some butter then add the spice mix consisting of the same spices used for the chicken. Toast the spices for 2 mins in the butter.
Add milk followed by cream cheese, parmesan cheese and chopped spinach. Mix gently till everything is melted, thickened and the spinach wilted.
Finally when the sauce is ready, chop your chicken into delicious cubes then serve with the mashed potatoes topped with the sauce and ENJOY!
macroNote: Oven Bake or Air Fry for 22-25mins at 200C / 400F. You can cook these on a pan in some butter too for 4-5 mins each side on medium heat. Toast the spices in butter for 2mins on low heat then add milk, cream cheese, parmesan and spinach. Keep stirring till smooth, creamy and slightly thick. Let this warm up for 3-4 mins and your sauce is ready. Slice your chicken into cubes then serve with the fluffy mash. I recommend storing the creamy sauce separately and serving when ready to eat

title: Halal Cart Chicken Rice Bowls
instructions: Slice the chicken breasts into small ½-inch cubes. In a bowl, combine with minced garlic, salt, oregano, smoked paprika, chilli flakes, cumin, olive oil, and lemon juice. Mix thoroughly until well coated.
Prepare the white sauce by whisking together yogurt, mayo, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and a squeeze of lemon juice until smooth. Transfer to a bottle and refrigerate.
Cook the white rice according to package instructions. Meanwhile, chop the lettuce, tomatoes, and cucumbers for the salad. Season the salad to taste - I like a light sprinkle of chilli flakes.
Heat a pan over medium-high heat with a knob of butter. Cook the marinated chicken for 3–4 minutes per side until golden brown and juicy.
Reduce the heat to low and add extra butter and freshly chopped coriander to the chicken. Stir until the chicken is evenly coated, then remove from heat and set aside. Repeat for all the chicken.
In the same pan, add chopped garlic and either harissa or tomato paste. Sauté for 2 minutes, then add additional spices with a dash of water. Stir for another minute until well combined.

Add the cooked rice to the pan and mix thoroughly until every grain is infused with the vibrant spice mix. Finally, serve the red rice alongside the chicken and salad, drizzle with the white sauce, and ENJOY!
macroNote: Marinate the chicken for at least 30 minutes—or overnight for deeper flavor. Cook the chicken in a little butter over medium-high heat for 3–4 minutes per side until a rich, golden-brown crust forms. Store the sauce in a bottle in the fridge for future meals—double the batch if needed. Keep the side salad separate or prepare fresh when serving.

title: Buffalo Chicken Potato Bowls
ingredients: ½ Tsp each: Salt, Black Pepper, Garlic Powder, Cumin
instructions: Slice the chicken breasts into small ½-inch cubes. Season with salt, parsley, garlic powder, cumin, smoked paprika, and olive oil. Toss until evenly coated, then set aside.

Chop the potatoes into small cubes and spread them on a lined sheet pan (use baking paper). Season with salt, smoked paprika, garlic powder, cumin, and parsley, then drizzle with olive oil or lightly coat with cooking spray. Mix till well coated.
Air fry or bake the seasoned potatoes in a preheated oven at 200°C/400°F for 18–20 minutes until golden and crispy.
While the potatoes cook, prepare the creamy buffalo sauce. In a bowl, combine buffalo hot sauce, yogurt, mayo, and honey. Mix until the sauce is smooth and slightly thick.
For the fresh salad, combine chopped tomatoes, red onions, cucumber, green onions, and parsley in a large bowl. Season with your preferred spices and a squeeze of lemon juice; toss thoroughly.

Heat a pan over medium-high heat and add butter. Cook the marinated chicken for 3-4 minutes per side until golden and charred. Once cooked, lower the heat and add additional buffalo hot sauce and a bit more butter, stirring to coat the chicken evenly.
Ensure the chicken is well coated, then serve it alongside the crispy potatoes and fresh salad. Drizzle with the creamy buffalo sauce, and ENJOY!
macroNote: Slice the chicken into smaller cubes than usual and season thoroughly—add extra if needed. Prepare the buffalo sauce and side salad in advance—store the sauce in a bottle in the fridge and keep the salad separate for easier reheating. Reheat chicken and potatoes in an air fryer at 200°C for 5–6 minutes to restore crispiness. Important: Lower the heat before adding buffalo sauce to the pan to ensure it coats the chicken properly.

title: Creamy Garlic Cheesy Chicken & Potatoes V2
ingredients: 1000g Raw Chicken Breast, cut into cubes
1 Tbsp (30g) Minced Garlic or Garlic Paste
1.5 Tsp Chilli Flakes (Optional if you don't like spicy)
80g Shredded Mozzarella or any Low Fat Cheese
1100g Raw Yellow or White Potatoes, cut into small cubes
instructions: First slice your chicken breasts into cubes then add minced garlic, salt, mixed herbs, smoked paprika, onion powder, chilli flakes and olive oil. Mix till the colour changes!
Now slice your raw potatoes into small cubes and place in a bowl. Season with salt, garlic powder, mixed herbs, paprika and olive oil. Mix till everything is well coated.
Place them on a lined sheet pan then oven bake or air fry for 20-22 mins till golden and crispy then set aside.

Next get a pan on medium heat, melt down butter then cook your chicken for 4-5 mins each side till golden and juicy. You want to develop a golden brown crust! Note: You will need to cook off all the chicken first before moving with the rest of the recipe.
Now lower the heat and add milk and garlic and herb cream cheese. Give this a mix till everything melts and is well combined.
Bring the sauce to a light bubble then add all your crispy potatoes in the pan with the chicken. Give it a gentle but thorough mix till fully incorporated.
Final touch, add a layer of shredded mozzarella over the top then cover the pan with a lid for 3-4 mins to let the cheese melt!
Finally distribute into 5 even servings and your high protein meals are ready to enjoy for the week!
macroNote: Cook the chicken on medium heat till you get a good sear. Don't overcrowd the pan and cook in batches. When adding all the dairy ingredients to the pan, make sure the pan is on low heat to prevent splitting.

title: Chimichurri Garlic Steak Bites & Cheesy Mashed Potatoes
instructions: Slice the beef steaks into cubes. In a bowl, season with salt, black pepper, parsley, oregano, garlic powder, smoked paprika, and olive oil. Mix until evenly coated.

Peel the potatoes and cut them into thick chunks. Place them in a pot of water and boil for 12–14 minutes until fork-tender. Drain then cover with a lid for 5 minutes to allow the remaining steam to evaporate any excess moisture.
Using a potato masher, mash the potatoes until smooth. Stir in evaporated milk, shredded mozzarella, garlic powder, salt, and pepper until the mash is creamy and cheesy.
Heat a pan over medium-high heat and add a little light butter. Sear the steak bites for about 2 minutes per side until they develop a golden, charred crust.

Lower the heat to low, then add extra butter, minced garlic, plenty of parsley, chilli flakes, and a squeeze of lemon juice. Stir until the beef is thoroughly coated in this chimichurri flavoured butter.
Serve the juicy steak bites alongside the cheesy mashed potatoes. Divide evenly into 4 containers for your high-protein meal prep, and ENJOY!
macroNote: Season steak bites generously; topside beef is a great lean option. Peel and cut potatoes into evenly sized chunks for even cooking. Boil for 12–14 minutes until fork-tender, then drain and let steam before mashing. After adding cheese and milk, mix well until the mash is smooth and the cheese is fully melted. Sear steak bites over medium-high heat for 2 minutes per side until a golden-brown crust forms—avoid overcrowding. Lower the heat before adding the chimichurri mix, stirring until fully coated. For reheating, warm everything in a pot on low heat for 5 minutes; add a splash of milk if the mash is dry.

title: Butter Chicken Loaded Fries
instructions: Slice the chicken into cubes and place in a bowl. Add fresh garlic, butter chicken spice mix, yogurt, and lemon juice. Toss until evenly coated and set aside to marinate.

Wash the potatoes and cut them into fries. Season with salt, garlic, paprika, cumin, garam masala, and olive oil. Toss well, then spread on a baking tray. Air fry at 200°C (400°F) for 20 minutes until golden and crispy.
While the fries are cooking, heat a pan over medium-high heat and melt butter. Add sliced onions and sauté for 5 minutes until soft and fragrant.
Stir in chopped tomatoes, extra butter chicken spice mix, and cashew nuts. Simmer for 8–10 minutes until the mixture reduces to a sauce-like consistency.
Turn off the heat and stir in yogurt. Let the mixture cool slightly before transferring it to a blender. Blend for 2–3 minutes until smooth. Allow the sauce to cool further if needed.
In a clean pan over high heat, cook the marinated chicken for 8 minutes until golden. Reduce the heat to medium and add the blended butter chicken sauce. Stir until the chicken is well coated.

Gently combine the chicken with the crispy fries. Top with cheese and cover the pan for 2 minutes to allow the cheese to melt. Garnish with freshly chopped coriander and a sprinkle of chilli flakes. Serve and ENJOY!
macroNote: Marinate the chicken for at least 30 minutes—or overnight for maximum flavor. If you don't have an air fryer, bake the fries in a preheated oven at 200°C/400°F for 20 minutes. Use fresh chopped tomatoes instead of canned for a brighter, fresher butter chicken sauce. Let the sauce cool completely before blending to avoid pressure build-up.

title: Beef Shawarma Mac n Cheese
instructions: Slice your sirloin beef into extra thin strips. Place in a bowl and add 2 servings of shawarma spice mix, olive oil, and lemon juice. Mix in thoroughly and set aside to marinate.
Bring a pot of water to a boil and add your macaroni pasta. Cook for 8 minutes until al dente, then reserve some pasta water, drain the rest, and set the pasta aside.
Prepare the red onion mix by thinly slicing 2 large red onions and combining them in a bowl with chopped parsley, sumac, and lemon juice. Mix well and set aside.

Heat a pan on high heat with some butter. Sear the marinated beef for 1–2 minutes, then reduce the heat to medium and add extra butter and parsley. Mix well for 1-2 minutes until evenly coated and golden brown. Remove the beef from the pan and set aside. Repeat for the remaining beef.
In the same pan, add extra shawarma spice mix to the leftover oil and toast for 2 minutes. Stir in evaporated milk, cream cheese, cheddar, and some reserved pasta water.
Keep the heat at medium-low and stir the sauce until it's smooth and creamy, letting it bubble slightly. Then add the cooked pasta and toss until creamy and well combined.
Divide the mac n cheese with the shawarma beef and sumac onion mix evenly into 4 containers, serve, and ENJOY!
macroNote: Slice the beef very thinly for quick cooking, tenderness, and maximum flavor absorption. Make sumac onions in batches and store them separately in the fridge for future meals. Toast the spices in the beef's residual oil for 1–2 minutes before adding milk to the mac sauce. Let it bubble, then lower the heat before mixing in the pasta. Reheat in a pan on low heat or in the microwave for 5 minutes.

title: Peri Peri Chicken & Spicy Rice
ingredients: 1 Tsp each: Salt, Cumin, Smoked Paprika, Chilli Powder, Turmeric
instructions: Trim any excess fat from the chicken thighs. In a bowl, combine with peri-peri spice mix, Nando's marinade, and a squeeze of lemon juice. Toss until well coated, then let it marinate for at least 30 minutes—or overnight for best flavor.
Prepare the peri-naise by mixing mayo, Nando's hot sauce, garlic powder, smoked paprika, and a squeeze of lemon juice until completely smooth. Transfer to a bottle and store in the fridge.

Heat a pan over medium-high heat and add a little butter. Cook the marinated chicken for about 5 minutes on each side until golden and juicy. Remove from the pan and set aside. Repeat for the remaining chicken.
In the same pan, add chopped garlic, onion, and bell pepper. Sauté for 3–4 minutes until soft, then stir in salt, cumin, smoked paprika, chilli powder, and turmeric.
Mix in the tomato paste and cook for another 3–4 minutes. Then add the cooked white rice and fresh parsley, stirring well until every grain of rice turns a bright yellow-orange color.
Serve and distribute the spicy rice evenly with the chicken and a generous drizzle of peri-naise then ENJOY!
macroNote: Marinate the chicken overnight for optimal flavor; chicken breast is a leaner alternative. Cook on medium high heat for 5 mins each side to develop that golden colour. Prepare the Perinaise sauce ahead of time, bottle it, and refrigerate until needed. Reheat the dish by warming it in a microwave or on a pan for 5 minutes.

title: Black Pepper Beef & Garlic Fried Rice
ingredients: 800g (28oz) Raw Topside/Top Sirloin Beef, thinly sliced
200g (7oz) Uncooked White Rice/540g Cooked Leftover Rice (basmati or jasmine)
1 Tsp Red Pepper Flakes to garnish
instructions: Slice the beef steaks into extra thin strips. In a bowl, combine with dark and light soy sauce, black pepper, garlic powder, baking soda, cornflour, and olive oil. Toss the beef until velvety, then set aside to marinate.
Prepare the black pepper sauce by whisking together beef broth, light and dark soy sauce, hoisin sauce, rice vinegar, black pepper, and cornflour in a separate bowl until smooth.

Heat a pan over high heat and add a little butter. Cook the marinated beef strips for 1–2 minutes per side until a golden, crispy crust forms. Remove the beef from the pan and set aside. Repeat for the remaining beef.
In the same pan, add sliced onions and bell peppers. Sauté for about 5 minutes until soft and fragrant, then return the crispy beef to the pan and pour in the black pepper sauce.
Stir the mixture and let it come to a gentle bubble so the sauce thickens slightly. Simmer on low heat for 3–5 minutes until everything is heated through, then remove from the heat and set aside.
For the garlic fried rice, heat another pan (or reuse the cleaned pan) over medium heat and melt a bit of butter. Sauté chopped garlic until golden and slightly crispy.
Add the leftover cooked rice along with a dash of soy sauce and red pepper flakes. Toss thoroughly until well combined. Serve the garlic rice alongside the black pepper beef and ENJOY!
macroNote: Use the “velveting” technique to tenderize the beef, helping it crisp up during cooking. Preheat the pan with a little butter, sear the beef on high heat for 1–2 minutes per side until golden, then set aside. After adding the sauce, let it simmer until thickened, ensuring the beef is well coated. For garlic fried rice, sauté garlic in butter until lightly golden, then mix in the leftover rice. Reheat in the microwave for 3–4 minutes or warm in a pan over low heat.

title: Crispy Spicy Beef Noodles
instructions: Prepare the sauce by combining light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, honey, sweet chilli sauce, rice vinegar, chilli garlic paste, red pepper flakes, sesame seeds, and water in a bowl. Stir until well blended.

Heat a pan over medium-high heat and melt a little butter. Add all the ground beef and cook for 6–8 minutes until browned and most of the liquid evaporates, breaking it up with a spatula while it cooks.
Reduce the heat to medium and stir in half of the prepared sauce along with chopped green onions. Continue cooking for 5 minutes until the beef becomes golden and crispy, then transfer to a plate.
Cook the noodles by placing them in boiling water for 5 minutes. Drain immediately to prevent overcooking.

In the same pan, add chopped garlic, ginger, and green onions. Sauté for 3–4 minutes until fragrant, then add sliced red onions and bell peppers. Cook for an additional 5 minutes until the vegetables are soft.
Return the crispy beef to the pan and add the remaining sauce along with the cooked noodles and extra green onions. Toss gently until everything is evenly coated and heated through. Serve and ENJOY!
macroNote: Cook the beef over medium-high heat for 6–8 minutes until most of the liquid evaporates, allowing a good sear before adding the sauce. After adding the sauce, cook for another 5 minutes until golden brown and crispy, then set aside. This dish tastes even better after a day in the fridge. Reheat in the microwave or in a pan with a splash of water to restore moisture.

title: Cheesy Beef Bolognaise & Potato Skillet
instructions: Wash the potatoes and cut them into small cubes. Finely chop the onions, celery, and garlic, and grate 2 medium carrots.
Place the potato cubes on a lined baking tray. Season with garlic powder, chilli flakes, paprika, oregano, basil, and a drizzle of olive oil. Toss until well coated.

Air fry or oven-bake the potatoes at 200°C (400°F) for 20 minutes. Meanwhile, heat a pan over medium heat, add light butter, and sauté the chopped onions, celery, garlic, and grated carrots for 5–6 minutes until soft.
Season the vegetable mix with salt and pepper, cook for another 2 minutes, then remove from the pan and set aside.
In the same pan, add a little extra light butter and increase the heat to medium-high. Cook the ground beef for 5–7 minutes, breaking it up with a spatula until slightly charred and fully cooked.
Stir in tomato paste, salt, basil, oregano, chilli flakes, and paprika, then add ½ cans of chopped tomatoes. Let the sauce simmer on low for 5 minutes, then stir in the reserved vegetable mix.
Mix thoroughly and add grated Parmesan. Cover the pan and simmer for 8–10 minutes to meld the flavors. Adjust seasoning and add a splash of water if needed.
Finally, add the crispy potatoes to the pan and gently fold them in until evenly combined. Top with mozzarella cheese and fresh parsley, cover until the cheese melts, then serve and ENJOY!
macroNote: Sauté the onions, carrots, and celery over medium heat for 5 minutes until softened, then set aside. Sear the beef over medium-high heat for 5–6 minutes until browned; then stir in tomato paste, spices, and chopped tomatoes. Return the sautéed celery mixture to the beef and simmer on low heat for 8–10 minutes to meld the flavors. Air fry or bake the potatoes at 200°C for 18–20 minutes until crisp. To reheat, warm the dish in a pan or microwave for 5 minutes.

title: Garlic Shrimp Fried Rice
instructions: Wash and devein the shrimp. In a bowl, marinate them with soy sauce, black pepper, garlic & onion powder, and chilli flakes. Toss until evenly coated, then set aside.
Prepare the yum yum sauce by combining light mayo, ketchup, sriracha, rice vinegar, ginger powder, and paprika. Mix until completely smooth. (You can bottle and store this sauce for later use)
Heat a pan over medium heat and add a little light butter. Cook the marinated raw shrimp for 1–2 minutes per side until golden and juicy, then set aside.
In the same pan, add chopped garlic and green onion; sauté for 2 minutes. Then add peas and carrots, cooking for another 2 minutes until the vegetables are tender.
Push the vegetables to one side of the pan, add the whisked eggs, and stir continuously until scrambled. Once the eggs are softly cooked, combine them with the vegetables.

Add your day-old cooked rice along with extra soy sauce, oyster sauce, and a dab of light butter. Toss well, then return the cooked shrimp and additional green onion to the pan. Mix until everything is evenly combined.
Give the dish a final toss, then divide into 4 servings. Drizzle generously with the yum yum sauce and serve. ENJOY!
macroNote: Use raw or par-cooked shrimp; if par-cooked, reduce the cooking time. Marinate for at least 30 minutes for enhanced flavor. If you don't have day-old rice, cook fresh rice and chill it in the freezer until cooled. Make the yum yum sauce in batches and store it for future meals. Reheat in a microwave or pan, and serve the sauce fresh when ready to eat.

title: Roasted Creamy Garlic Chicken & Broccoli
ingredients: 5 Whole Garlic Cloves (to roast for the white sauce)
instructions: Butterfly cut the chicken breasts and season both sides evenly with oregano, garlic powder, chilli flakes, paprika, and olive oil. Set aside to marinate.
Wash and chop the broccoli into small florets. Place on a tray and toss with chilli flakes, garlic powder, salt, pepper, grated Parmesan, thinly sliced red onion, and olive oil.
Arrange 5 whole garlic cloves in the center of the tray. Air fry or oven bake the broccoli for 15–16 minutes at 200°C (400°F).
While the broccoli cooks, heat a pan over medium heat and cook the seasoned chicken for 5–6 minutes per side until golden and juicy. Let the chicken rest, then cut it into cubes.

Remove the roasted garlic cloves from the tray. In a blender, combine yogurt, mayo, the roasted garlic, crumbled feta, honey, and lemon juice. Blend until completely smooth to create your white sauce.

Layer the broccoli on a serving dish, top with the chicken cubes, and drizzle with the white sauce. Gently mix with two large spoons until well combined. Garnish with crushed walnuts and serve. ENJOY!
macroNote: For the juiciest chicken, cook on medium heat for 5–6 minutes per side, then let it rest before chopping into cubes. Oven-bake or air-fry the broccoli at 200°C/400°F for 15–16 minutes, taking care not to burn it to avoid a bitter flavor. This dish stores well in the fridge and tastes great cold, or reheat in the air fryer at 180°C/370°F for 5 minutes. It pairs wonderfully with sourdough bread.

title: Creamy Lemon Garlic Shrimp Linguine
ingredients: 230g (8.1oz) Uncooked Linguine Pasta (or pasta of choice)
instructions: Marinate the raw shrimp by mixing with minced garlic, Italian herbs, chilli flakes, smoked paprika, salt, lemon juice, and olive oil. Mix thoroughly and set aside.
Cook your linguine (or pasta of your choice) in boiling water for 7-8 minutes until al dente. Reserve some pasta water for the sauce, then drain the pasta.

Heat a pan over medium heat and add a little light butter. Sauté the marinated shrimp for about 2 minutes per side until golden. Lower the heat, then add a bit more butter, fresh parsley, and a squeeze of lemon juice. Toss to coat, then remove the shrimp from the pan and set aside.
In the same pan on low heat, combine milk, light cream cheese, Parmesan, extra seasoning, and some reserved pasta water. Stir continuously until the sauce thickens and becomes creamy.

Add the cooked pasta along with a handful of spinach, the cooked shrimp, extra parsley, and another squeeze of lemon juice. Toss everything until well combined, top with additional Parmesan, and serve. ENJOY!
macroNote: Marinate shrimp with garlic powder (if desired) and skip olive oil for lower calories. After cooking, reduce heat and add butter, fresh parsley, and a squeeze of lemon for extra flavor. When preparing the sauce, keep the heat low before adding milk and cream cheese; stir slowly until thickened, then fold in the pasta.

title: Chicken Tikka Masala & Veggie Garlic Rice
ingredients: 150g Mixed Vegetables (Frozen or Fresh Carrot, Sweetcorn, Green Beans and Peas)
instructions: Cut the chicken breast into cubes. In a mixing bowl, combine the chicken with yogurt, tikka masala spice mix, fresh minced garlic, and ginger. Mix thoroughly, then set aside to marinate.
Place the chicken cubes on a lined baking tray and air fry at 200°C for 20 minutes until golden and charred. Meanwhile, prepare the rice and sauce.

In a pot over medium heat, add butter and mixed vegetables. Sauté for 3–4 minutes until softened, then stir in fresh garlic, salt, turmeric, and cumin seeds. Cook for an additional 5 minutes until fragrant.
Add the washed, uncooked rice to the pot and stir to combine. Pour in water, bring to a gentle boil, then reduce the heat and simmer for 8 minutes until the rice is fully cooked and fluffy.

In a separate pan over medium heat, melt butter and sauté chopped onions for 2 minutes. Stir in extra tikka masala spice mix and blended tomatoes, then cook for 8 minutes until the sauce thickens into a curry consistency.

Remove the sauce from the heat and stir in cream cheese until silky smooth and creamy. Fold in the cooked chicken, mixing well. Garnish with fresh coriander, then serve with the fragrant vegetable rice and ENJOY!
macroNote: Cook the chicken in an air fryer or oven for 20 minutes until juicy and golden; pan-cooking works too. For a smoother sauce, blend the tomatoes thoroughly before adding to the pan. Prepare the rice in advance or cook it simultaneously with the chicken. For fluffy rice, bring the water to a boil, then lower the heat, cover, and simmer until fully cooked.

title: Cheeseburger Potato Bowls
instructions: Wash and slice the sweet potatoes into small cubes. Arrange them on a tray and season with salt, black pepper, garlic & onion powder, smoked paprika, and olive oil.
Toss the potatoes until evenly coated, then bake or air fry at 200°C (400°F) for 25–30 minutes until golden crispy.

Meanwhile, prepare the special sauce. In a bowl, combine light mayo, ketchup, yellow mustard, onion powder, black pepper, smoked paprika, and pickle juice. Mix until smooth. (You can bottle and refrigerate the sauce for later use)
For the pickle salad, shred the lettuce and combine it in a bowl with chopped red onion, tomatoes, and pickles. Toss well and set aside.
Heat a pan over medium-high heat and add butter. Cook the ground beef for 6–8 minutes until a deep, brown crust forms, stirring with a spatula to break up the meat. Season with salt and pepper.

Once the beef is cooked, add a little more butter to the pan and mix it through. Serve the beef (topped with a sprinkle of cheese, if desired) alongside the crispy sweet potatoes, fresh salad, and a generous drizzle of the special sauce. ENJOY!
macroNote: While the potatoes are cooking, prepare both the special sauce and salad to save time. Be sure to include the pickle juice in the sauce—it adds a fantastic flavor. Bottle the sauce and store it in the fridge. For the salad, store the lettuce separately from the other vegetables to prevent sogginess; combine them just before serving. Reheat the beef and potatoes together on low heat in a pan or in an air fryer for 5 minutes.

title: Buttery Garlic Steak & Eggs
ingredients: Optional 2 Tsp Olive Oil (or cooking spray)
instructions: Slice the steaks into 1-inch cubes then season with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, parsley, and olive oil. Mix thoroughly until evenly coated then set aside.

Cut the potatoes into small cubes and season with salt, black pepper, cumin, paprika, and garlic powder. Add a drizzle of olive oil or use cooking spray. Toss well, then spread them on a lined baking sheet. Oven-bake or air-fry at 200°C (400°F) for 20–22 minutes until golden and crispy.
For the spicy sauce, blend together yogurt, light mayo, chipotle chilli paste, salt, paprika, and garlic powder until smooth and creamy. Transfer to a squeezy bottle for easy storage.

Heat a pan over high heat, melt some butter, and sear the seasoned steak bites for 2–3 minutes per side until golden brown and charred. Lower the heat, add fresh minced garlic and fresh parsley, and toss until coated in the garlicky butter then set aside.
In the same pan over medium-low heat, add whisked eggs and stir continuously until scrambled and fluffy. Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Evenly distribute the steak bites, crispy potatoes, and scrambled eggs into 4 servings. Drizzle with the spicy sauce and ENJOY!
macroNote: Marinate the steak for 15-30mins to allow the seasonings to fully absorb. Prepare the spicy sauce in batches—it can be stored in the fridge for weeks. Cook the steak on high heat for 2 minutes per side to develop a flavorful crust. Oven-bake or air-fry the potatoes at 200°C (400°F) for 20–22 minutes until crispy. Cook the eggs over medium low heat, stirring continuously until fluffy. To reheat, place everything in a pan before serving then drizzle with the spicy sauce.

title: Chicken Gyros Bowls
instructions: Slice the chicken breast cutlets and boneless thighs into halves. Marinate with minced garlic, Gyros spice mix, olive oil, yogurt, lemon juice, and lemon zest. Mix thoroughly until evenly coated.

Thread the marinated chicken onto skewers and place on a lined baking tray. Oven-bake or air-fry at 200°C (400°F) for 25 minutes until golden brown and juicy then set aside covered to rest and keep warm.

Cut the raw potatoes into fries and season with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, paprika, and a drizzle of olive oil. Toss until well coated, then oven-bake or air-fry at 200°C (400°F) for 20–25 minutes until crispy and golden brown. (If space allows, cook the chicken and fries together to save time)
For the tzatziki sauce, mix yogurt, grated cucumber, a pinch of salt, and lemon juice in a bowl. Stir until smooth and creamy, then refrigerate until ready to serve.
To prepare the garlic naan, combine flour, yogurt, salt, garlic powder, and baking powder in a bowl. Mix gently until crumbly, then knead into a smooth dough ball.

Divide the dough into four equal smaller balls, then roll each one out as thin as possible without tearing. Melt a little butter in a pan over medium-low heat and cook the naan for 2–3 minutes per side until golden and fully cooked through.
Roughly chop the cooked chicken into bite-sized cubes. Serve with crispy fries, warm garlic naan, a fresh side salad, and creamy tzatziki sauce. ENJOY!
macroNote: Marinate the chicken overnight for maximum flavor. Prepare the naan dough in advance to save time. Air-fry the chicken and fries together if space allows for a quicker cook time. Make the tzatziki sauce ahead of time and store it in the fridge until ready to serve. When reheating, keep the salad separate. Reheat the chicken and fries in the air fryer for 5 minutes at 180°C (370°F) for the best texture.

title: Golden Steak Fried Rice
ingredients: 800g (28oz) Raw Topside/Top Sirloin Beef, thinly sliced
4 Whole Eggs (separate egg yolks from egg whites)
instructions: Slice the beef into thin strips and place in a mixing bowl. Marinate with black pepper, light and dark soy sauce, oyster sauce, and baking soda. Mix thoroughly until velvety and well combined then set aside.
Separate the egg yolks from the whites. In a large bowl, combine the cooked rice with the yolks, mixing until every grain is coated in a golden yellow hue.

Heat a pan over medium-high heat and melt butter. Cook the marinated beef strips for 2–3 minutes per side until a crispy crust forms. Avoid overcrowding the pan to ensure even browning. Once cooked, set the beef aside.
In the same pan on medium-low heat, add the white parts of the green onion along with minced garlic. Sauté for 3–4 minutes until fragrant.
Push the sautéed onions and garlic to one side of the pan, then add the egg whites. Stir continuously until scrambled, then mix them with the onions.

Add the golden-coated rice to the pan, along with extra soy sauce, the green parts of the green onion, a small knob of butter, and the cooked beef. Give everything a thoroug mix until well combined and flavourful.
Serve and distribute evenly into 4 portions, add a drizzle of sriracha and your high protein meals are ready to enjoy!
macroNote: Marinate the beef for at least 30 minutes to enhance flavor and tenderness. Mix the egg yolks into the cooked rice in a bowl first to ensure every grain is evenly coated before cooking. Sear the steak strips in butter or olive oil over medium-high heat for 2–3 minutes per side until browned and crispy.

title: Mongolian Beef Noodles
ingredients: 700g (25oz) Raw Topside/Top Sirloin Beef, cut into thin strips
Garnish with Chilli Flakes & Sesame Seeds
instructions: Slice the beef steaks into extra-thin strips. Marinate with light and dark soy sauce, garlic powder, black pepper, baking soda, olive oil, and cornflour. Mix thoroughly until velvety and well coated, then let it marinate for 15 minutes.
While the beef marinates, cook the egg noodles according to packet instructions or boil for 4–5 minutes until slightly underdone. Drain and rinse under cold water to stop the cooking process.
Heat a pan over medium-high heat and spray with cooking oil. Cook the marinated beef for 2–3 minutes per side until golden brown and crispy, then set aside. Repeat for the remaining beef.

In the same pan over medium heat, add chopped garlic, the white part of the green onion, and red onion. Cook for 4–5 minutes until fragrant, then pour in soy sauce, oyster sauce, and water. Bring to a light simmer, then stir in a cornstarch slurry.
Let the sauce thicken slightly, then add the cooked beef, the green part of the green onion, and the cooked noodles. Toss everything together until fully combined and coated in the rich sauce.
Garnish with chili flakes and sesame seeds, then divide into 4 equal servings. ENJOY!
macroNote: Marinate the beef for at least 15 minutes to allow the baking soda to tenderize it properly. Use cooking spray when searing the beef—cook for 2–3 minutes per side to avoid overcooking. Let the sauce simmer and bubble before adding the cornflour slurry. Allow it to thicken for 2–3 minutes before returning the beef. Cook the noodles as per packet instructions—I simmered mine in boiling water on low heat for 5–6 minutes.

title: Korean Fried Chicken
ingredients: 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes (omit for no spice)
210g (7.4oz) Uncooked White Rice/560g Cooked Rice (140g per serving)
instructions: Slice the chicken breasts into bite-sized cubes, then season with garlic powder, black pepper, paprika, salt, and cornflour. Mix until evenly coated then set aside.
Cook your rice by bringing a pot of water to a boil and simmering for 8–10 minutes until fully cooked. I use basmati rice, but jasmine rice works too! Once done, set aside.
Heat a pan over medium heat, add olive oil, and cook the coated chicken for 4 minutes per side until golden brown with a crispy crust. Set aside and repeat for any remaining chicken.

In the same pan on low heat, add soy sauce mixed with water, a drizzle of honey, and gochujang paste. Stir gently until smooth and well combined. Let it simmer for 2–3 minutes until thickened, then return the crispy chicken and mix until fully coated in the spicy glaze.

For the cucumber salad, thinly slice cucumber and place in a bowl. Add light & dark soy sauce, rice vinegar, garlic powder, chili flakes, and a generous amount of sesame seeds. Mix well until combined and fragrant. Serve alongside the glazed chicken and hot rice, then ENJOY!
macroNote: Ensure the chicken is fully coated in cornflour for extra crispiness, or skip it if unavailable. When making the glaze, add ingredients over low heat, stirring continuously until it lightly bubbles, then let it reduce for 3–4 minutes until thickened. Store the cucumber salad separately and reheat the meal without it—it's best served cold.

title: Chicken Biryani
ingredients: ½ Tsp Salt or to taste
instructions: Slice the chicken breasts into medium cubes. Marinate with minced garlic and ginger, garam masala, salt, paprika, cumin, turmeric, yogurt, lemon juice, and olive oil. Mix thoroughly then set aside to marinate for 30 minutes or overnight for best flavour.
Meanwhile, wash and cook the basmati rice, then thinly slice the red onions and chop up the tomatoes to use for later.

Spread the sliced onions on a lined baking tray, spray with a little olive oil, and toss to coat. Oven-bake or air-fry at 190°C (380°F) for 10–12 minutes until golden and crispy. Keep an eye on them to prevent burning.
While the onions cook, heat a pan over medium high heat, melt some butter, and cook the marinated chicken cubes for 4 minutes per side until golden brown and charred.
Once cooked, lower the heat, then add half of the crispy onions, the chopped tomatoes, freshly chopped coriander, extra salt to taste, and garam masala.

Give this a thorough mix until combined, cover, and cook on low heat for 10 minutes until the tomatoes break down into a thick curry sauce. Use a spatula to help mash them. This will smell incredibly fragrant!

Once the chicken curry is ready, start layering in the pan: chicken mix, rice, lemon slices, crispy onions, and chopped coriander. Repeat the layers once more and finsih the last layer with saffron infused water.
Cover for 5-10 mins on low heat to let the flavours intensify between the layers. Once done, you're ready to serve and divide evenly into 4 portions and ENJOY!

title: Creamy Spicy Salmon Ramen Noodles
instructions: Slice the skinless salmon into equal fillets/steaks. Season both sides with garlic powder, smoked paprika, salt, and black pepper. Rub the spices in evenly for maximum flavor absorption.
Heat a pan over medium heat, add a little olive oil, and cook the seasoned salmon for 4–5 minutes per side until beautifully golden brown and seared. Set aside to rest, keeping it warm.

While the salmon cooks, prepare your noodles according to package instructions or boil for 5 minutes until slightly underdone (they'll finish cooking in the sauce). Drain and rinse under cold water to stop the cooking process, then set aside.

In the same pan over medium-low heat, sauté chopped garlic for 2 minutes until fragrant. Add chili garlic paste and light coconut milk, then season with salt, black pepper, and paprika. Simmer for 4–5 minutes until slightly thickened.
Add the cooked noodles, chopped green onion, and light & dark soy sauce. Mix gently until combined, then let it simmer for 3-4 minutes to thicken further.
Serve and divide the creamy noodles with the juicy seared salmon on top into 4 portions, and ENJOY!
macroNote: Follow the packet instructions for cooking the noodles (I simmered mine for 5 minutes). After adding the coconut milk, bring it to a light bubble before adding the noodles. Once added, mix well and let it simmer for a few minutes to thicken the sauce. Serve the salmon on top and enjoy! For meal prep, store the salmon and noodles separately for easier reheating.

title: Dynamite Chicken Loaded Fries
ingredients: 2 Tsp Olive Oil or Cooking Spray
instructions: Slice the chicken breasts into cubes and season with oregano, garlic powder, onion powder, black pepper, soy sauce, and cornflour. Mix thoroughly until evenly coated.

Cut the potatoes into fries, then season with salt, pepper, oregano, paprika, garlic powder, and olive oil. Mix well, then spread on a lined baking tray then oven-bake or air fry for 20-22 minutes at 200°C (400°F) until golden and crispy.
For the dynamite sauce, combine mayo, chili garlic sauce, sriracha, sweet chili sauce, and lemon juice in a bowl. Mix until smooth and set aside.
Heat a pan over medium-high heat, add a little olive oil, and cook the seasoned chicken for 4 minutes per side until golden and a crispy crust forms then set aside. Repeat for the remaining chicken.
Mix in the cooked juicy chicken in the dynamite sauce until fully coated and indulgent.
Distribute the crispy fries and saucy dynamite chicken into 4 equal servings, garnish with green onion and sesame seeds, then ENJOY!
macroNote: Ensure the chicken is well coated in cornflour for the crispiest texture. To reduce calories, skip the cornflour—the chicken will still be flavorful! If air frying, use cooking spray instead of olive oil and avoid over-seasoning the fries. Make the dynamite sauce in batches for easy storage; swap chili garlic sauce for chili flakes and garlic powder if needed.

title: Crispy Orange Chicken Noodles
ingredients: Sprinkle Chilli Flakes (omit for less heat)
instructions: Slice the chicken breasts into bite-sized cubes. Season with salt, pepper, garlic powder, paprika, and cornflour. Mix thoroughly until well coated, then set aside.
Cook the egg noodles according to packet instructions. Once done, rinse under cold water to stop the cooking process, then set aside.
Heat a pan over medium-high heat, add olive oil, and cook the seasoned chicken for 4 minutes per side until golden and a crispy crust forms. Set aside and repeat with any remaining chicken.
In the same pan over medium heat, add chopped garlic, ginger, and chili flakes. Cook for 2 minutes until fragrant, then stir in orange juice, soy sauce, honey, and orange zest.
Let the sauce bubble and reduce for 5 minutes on medium-low heat. Once it slightly thickens, add a cornstarch slurry (water mixed with cornstarch), stirring until the sauce further thickens.
Return the crispy chicken to the pan and coat it well in the sauce. Add the cooked noodles and chopped green onion, then mix everything until well combined and evenly coated.
Finally garnish with sesame seeds and chili flakes, divide into 4 portions, and ENJOY!
macroNote: Make sure the chicken pieces are evenly coated with corn flour. Cook the noodles in advance, according to packet instructions. I put mine in boiled water for 4-5 mins. Rinse the noodles in cold water after cooked to stop the cooking process. Let the orange juice reduce and thicken.

title: Creamy Garlic Cheesy Steak & Potatoes
ingredients: 2 Tsp Mixed Herbs (Parsley, Oregano, Thyme, Rosemary)
instructions: Slice the beef steaks into 1-inch cubes and place them in a mixing bowl. Add minced garlic, salt, black pepper, mixed herbs, smoked paprika, and olive oil. Mix well until evenly coated, then set aside.

Slice the potatoes into small cubes, then season with garlic powder, mixed herbs, smoked paprika, and olive oil. Toss to coat, then spread evenly on a lined baking tray. Bake in a preheated oven or air fry at 200°C (400°F) for 20–23 minutes until golden and crispy.

While the potatoes cook, heat a pan over medium-high heat, melt some butter, and sear the seasoned steak bites for 3 minutes per side until a golden-brown crust forms. Remove from the pan and set aside. Repeat for the remaining steak bites.

In the same pan over medium heat, add chopped onions, mushrooms, and cherry tomatoes. Cook for 5 minutes until softened, then lower the heat and stir in milk, cream cheese, and grated parmesan. Stir continuously for 3–4 minutes until the sauce is smooth, thick, and creamy.

Add a squeeze of lemon juice for tanginess, then return the steak bites and crispy potatoes to the pan. Stir everything together until fully incorporated. Sprinkle cheddar cheese and chili flakes, then serve and ENJOY!
macroNote: Marinate the steak bites for at least 30 minutes, or overnight, for deeper flavor. Sauté the onions, mushrooms, and tomatoes for 5–8 minutes until softened before adding the milk and cream cheese. Lower the heat when adding milk and cream cheese to prevent the sauce from splitting. Let the creamy sauce come to a light bubble, then add lemon juice for a tangy kick. This meal prep freezes well for weeks and reheats easily in a pan or microwave while staying fresh and flavorful.

title: Butter Chicken Shawarma Rice Bowls
ingredients: 800g (28oz) Raw Chicken Breast, cut into thin strips
½ Tsp each: Salt, Pepper, Garlic Powder
instructions: Slice the chicken breasts into thin strips, then marinate with minced garlic, tomato paste, salt, pepper, onion powder, cinnamon, paprika, olive oil, and lemon juice. Mix thoroughly and let it marinate.
For the golden rice, bring a pot of water to a boil and add raw basmati rice with salt, turmeric, and paprika. Stir and cook for 8–10 minutes until fully cooked and fluffy.
Lay the marinated chicken flat on a lined sheet pan, ensuring an even layer, then oven bake or air fry at 190°C (375°F) for 12–15 minutes until golden brown and slightly charred.
While the chicken cooks, heat a pan over medium heat, melt some butter, and sauté sliced onions for 5 minutes until soft. Add fresh tomatoes, cashew nuts, and butter chicken seasoning.
Mix well and let it cook for 5–7 minutes on medium-low heat until the tomatoes break down. Lower the heat and stir in yogurt until fully combined.
Allow the mixture to cool, then blend for 3–4 minutes until completely smooth.
Reheat the sauce in a pan before serving, or store it in a squeeze bottle for easy use.
By now, the chicken shawarma should be done. Prepare the quick side salad, then serve everything evenly with golden rice and a generous drizzle of butter chicken sauce. Enjoy
macroNote: Marinate the chicken overnight for maximum flavor. Oven bake for 15 minutes at 190°C (375°F) or air fry for 12 minutes at the same temperature. Cook the golden rice while the chicken is in the oven or air fryer to save time. Prepare the butter chicken sauce first before cooking the chicken and rice for better workflow. Add a splash of milk before blending the butter chicken sauce for a smoother consistency. Store the sauce in a squeeze bottle for easy serving or spoon it over when ready to eat.

title: Creamy Chicken Alfredo
ingredients: 1 Tsp each: Italian Herbs, Salt, Black Pepper
instructions: Slice the chicken breasts into thinner fillets, then season both sides with Italian herbs, smoked paprika, garlic powder, salt, pepper, and olive oil. Rub the seasoning in evenly, then set aside.
Cook the pasta. Bring a pot of salted water to a boil, add the spaghetti pasta, and cook for 8 minutes until al dente. Reserve some pasta water, then drain the rest.
Prepare the Alfredo sauce by blending milk, cream cheese, parmesan, Italian herbs, salt, pepper, and the reserved pasta water until smooth. Then set aside.
Heat a pan over medium heat with a little olive oil. Cook the seasoned chicken for 3–4 minutes per side until golden brown. Keep an eye on the spices to prevent burning. Once done, set aside.

In the same pan, sauté chopped garlic and onion over medium heat for 2–3 minutes until fragrant. Lower the heat, then pour in the blended Alfredo sauce. Stir continuously with a whisk until thick and creamy.
Add the cooked spaghetti to the sauce, mixing gently until fully coated. Serve with the sliced chicken, garnish with parsley, and drizzle with extra sauce. Enjoy!
macroNote: Ensure both sides of the chicken are evenly coated with seasoning. Cook the chicken over medium-low heat for 3–4 minutes per side to prevent the seasoning from burning. When adding the Alfredo sauce, keep the heat on low and stir gently until it thickens, then mix in the cooked pasta.

title: Chicken Chow Mein Noodles
ingredients: 700g (25oz) Raw Chicken Breast, cut into thin strips
instructions: Slice the chicken breasts into thin strips and place them in a mixing bowl. Marinate with paprika, black pepper, garlic powder, and light & dark soy sauce. Mix thoroughly and let sit for a few minutes to deepen the flavour.

Slice the red onion, bell pepper, and green onion. Cook the noodles according to package instructions—I boiled and simmered them in water for 4–5 minutes. Drain, rinse under cold water, and set aside.
Heat a pan over medium heat, add cooking spray or olive oil, and cook the marinated chicken for 6-8 minutes until golden brown and slightly charred. Set aside and repeat if needed.

In the same pan over medium-high heat, stir-fry the sliced onion, bell pepper, and green onion for 5 minutes till fragrant. Add minced garlic, soy sauce, oyster sauce, rice vinegar, and the cooked noodles. Mix gently but thoroughly until well combined.
Finally add the cooked chicken and bean sprouts, mix again, then garnish with sesame seeds and chili flakes. Distribute into 4 servings and ENJOY!
macroNote: Marinate the chicken for at least 30 minutes for deeper flavor. Cook the noodles according to package instructions—I simmered them in boiling water for 4–5 minutes. Prep all vegetables before cooking the chicken to streamline the process. Adjust seasoning by adding extra soy sauce or oyster sauce after mixing in the cooked noodles.

title: Chipotle Steak Bowls
ingredients: 800g (28oz) Raw Topside/Top Sirloin Beef, 1 Inch Thick Steaks
½ Tsp each: Garlic Powder, Salt, Black Pepper
210g (7.4oz) Uncooked Basmati Rice (or rice of choice)
instructions: Season both sides of the steaks evenly with garlic powder, parsley, paprika, cumin, salt, pepper, and olive oil. Rub the spices in until evenly coated and the color deepens then set aside.
Make the avocado sauce by blending avocado, yogurt, fresh coriander, garlic powder, salt, and black pepper until smooth and creamy. Transfer to a squeezy bottle for easy storage.
For the coriander lime rice, bring water to a boil in a pot, add the raw basmati rice, then simmer and cook for 8–10 minutes until fully cooked and fluffy.
Once cooked, stir in a generous handful of chopped coriander, fresh lime juice, and salt to taste. Gently mix until well combined and fluffed up, then set aside.

Heat a pan over medium heat, add a little olive oil or butter and cook the marinated steaks for 4 minutes per side, adjusting based on thickness. They should come out seared and golden brown. Let them rest for 4–5 minutes before slicing into juicy cubes.

Make the pico salsa by combining chopped tomato, red onion, red and green bell peppers, freshly chopped coriander, salt, pepper, and lime juice. Mix until well incorporated. Store this separately for easier reheating.
Serve the sliced steak with the coriander lime rice, pico de gallo, avocado sauce, and your choice of extra sides. Distribute evenly into 4 servings and ENJOY!
macroNote: Marinate the steak for at least 15-20 minutes—overnight is ideal for maximum flavor. Cook the steak on medium heat to prevent the spices from burning. For a thick steak, cook for 4 minutes per side, then flip and cook for another 2 minutes per side. For easy reheating, store the lettuce, salsa, sweetcorn, beans, and avocado sauce separately and add them fresh when ready to eat. Prepare the salsa and avocado sauce in advance and refrigerate for a few days for convenient future use.

title: Korean Beef Fried Rice
ingredients: 200g (7oz) Uncooked White Rice or 530g Leftover Cooked Rice
instructions: In a mixing bowl, combine light & dark soy sauce, honey, minced garlic and gochujang. Mix until smooth and well combined. You will use this sauce for the both the beef and rice.
Heat a pan over medium-high heat, add olive oil, then cook the minced beef for 6 minutes until fully browned with no pink bits remaining. Use a spatula to break up the meat while it cooks.

Lower the heat to medium, add half of the prepared Korean sauce along with chopped green onions and sesame seeds. Stir well and cook for another 4–5 minutes until the beef turns golden and crispy then set aside.
In the same pan over medium heat, add chopped onions and grated carrots. Cook for 5 minutes until softened, then push them to one side of the pan and add the whisked eggs.
Continuously stir the eggs until scrambled, then mix them with the vegetables until well incorporated.
Add your leftover cooked rice to the pan along with the remaining Korean sauce and more chopped green onions. Stir thoroughly until every grain of rice is evenly coated.
Return the cooked crispy beef to the pan and gently mix until fully incorporated. Garnish with sesame seeds.

For the Korean spicy sauce, mix together light mayo, gochujang, garlic powder, and rice vinegar until smooth. Serve the beef fried rice evenly into 4 portions with a drizzle of spicy Korean sauce and ENJOY!
macroNote: Use half of the sauce for the beef and the other half for the fried rice. If needed, add extra soy sauce or mix in a little water to increase volume. When cooking the beef, let most of the moisture evaporate before adding the sauce. Allow it to cook for a few minutes until golden brown and crispy. Swap whole eggs for egg whites if preferred. Cook on low heat until scrambled for a softer texture. After adding the sauce to the rice, mix thoroughly and cook for 3–4 minutes before adding the beef to ensure even flavor distribution.

title: Honey Crispy Chicken Mac n Cheese
ingredients: ½ Tsp each: Garlic Powder, Onion Powder, Smoked Paprika, Salt, Black Pepper
200g (7oz) Uncooked Macaroni Pasta (or pasta of choice)
½ Tsp each: Garlic Powder, Onion Powder, Smoked Paprika, Salt, Black Pepper
instructions: Slice the chicken into bite-sized pieces, then season with garlic powder, onion powder, paprika, salt, pepper, hot sauce and whisked eggs. Mix well until evenly coated in the wet batter. Set up the crushed cornflakes coating station.
While the chicken marinates, cook the macaroni in boiling water according to packet instructions. Reserve some pasta water before draining, then set aside.
Drop and coat each chicken piece in the crushed cornflakes station. Ensure every piece is evenly coated for a crispy finish.

Place the coated chicken bites on a lined baking tray or in the air fryer basket. Spray lightly with cooking spray, then oven bake or air fry at 200°C (400°F) for 18–20 minutes, until crispy and golden.
In a blender, combine milk, cream cheese, grated cheddar, and the same spices used for the chicken. Blend until smooth and creamy.

Pour the blended sauce into a pan over medium-low heat. Stir for 2–3 minutes until slightly thickened, then add the cooked macaroni along with some reserved pasta water to adjust consistency. Mix well until the pasta is creamy and fully coated. Garnish with parsley.
Make the sticky glaze by combining honey, hot sauce and squeeze of lemon juice. Drizzle over the crispy chicken bites till well coated.
macroNote: Air fry at 200°C for 18 minutes or oven bake at 200°C for 25 minutes until golden and crispy. Adding egg wash helps the crumbs stick better to the chicken for a crispier coating. When coating, let excess egg drip off before pressing into the crumbs for an even layer. You can use chicken strips instead of cubes—slice them into smaller pieces when serving if preferred. No blender? Simply mix the sauce ingredients directly in the pan over low heat until smooth and creamy. Store chicken and mac separately for meal prep. Air fry the chicken to make it crispy again when reheating.

title: Beef Bulgogi Kimchi Fried Rice
ingredients: 900g (32oz) Raw Topside/Top Sirloin Beef, cut into thin strips
instructions: Slice your beef into thin strips. Place in a mixing bowl and marinate with light and dark soy sauce, black pepper, chili flakes, chili powder, garlic paste, ginger paste, sesame seeds, and olive oil. Mix thoroughly until all pieces are well coated, then set aside to marinate while you prep other ingredients.

Heat a pan over medium-high heat, add a small amount of light butter, and sear the marinated beef for 2–3 minutes per side until golden brown and slightly crispy. Do not overcrowd the pan—work in batches to ensure the beef sears properly. Once cooked, set the beef aside.

In the same pan on medium heat, add a bit more butter if needed, then sauté chopped garlic, gochujang paste, chopped green onion (white parts), and grated carrots. Stir-fry for 2–3 minutes until fragrant and the vegetables have softened slightly.

Add your cooked jasmine rice to the pan and stir well, ensuring each grain gets coated in the gochujang mixture. Cook for 2–3 minutes, mixing until the rice turns a vibrant orange color and is heated through.

To the rice, add kimchi juice, chopped kimchi, additional green onion (green parts), and a splash of soy sauce. Mix thoroughly till well incorporated, and cook for another 2–3 minutes so the flavors meld.
Finally, add the cooked beef back into the pan. Gently mix everything together. Let it heat through for another 1–2 minutes. Garnish with extra sesame seeds, divide into 4 servings, and ENJOY!
macroNote: Marinate the beef for at least 1 hour or overnight for deeper flavor. Sear on high heat for 2–3 minutes per side to develop a rich, golden crust. Day-old jasmine rice is best for texture, but freshly cooked works if cooled properly. Store in bulk in the fridge or freezer—reheat in a pan or microwave for a few minutes when ready to eat.

title: Creamy Garlic Pepper Steak
ingredients: Season with Mixed Herbs, Salt, Chilli Flakes
instructions: Slice your beef steaks into thin strips, then season with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, paprika, chilli flakes, and olive oil. Mix well and marinate for at least 15 minutes (or longer for deeper flavor).

Prepare the seasoned rice. In a pot, add water and raw rice, bring to a boil, then lower to a simmer and cook for 8–10 minutes until fully cooked. Once done, season with mixed herbs, salt, and chilli flakes. Stir to combine until fragrant and set aside.
Heat a pan over medium-high heat, add light butter, and cook the marinated beef for 5–6 minutes until golden brown and juicy. Avoid overcrowding the pan for best sear.
Lower the heat to medium-low, then add milk, cream cheese, grated parmesan, extra salt, black pepper, and garlic powder.
Stir everything together until smooth and creamy. Add a large handful of spinach and mix it in. Let it simmer for 5–8 minutes until the sauce thickens and spinach is wilted.
Once the sauce is ready, serve with the seasoned rice, distribute evenly into 4 portions, and ENJOY your high-protein meals!
macroNote: Slice the steaks into thin strips to keep the beef tender during cooking. Marinate for at least 30 minutes (or longer) for deeper flavor. Cook on high heat for 5–6 minutes to develop a golden-brown crust for extra flavor. Lower the heat before adding the milk, cheese, and remaining ingredients to prevent splitting.

title: Mexican Style Chicken & Rice
ingredients: 1 Tsp each: Oregano, Garlic Powder, Paprika, Cumin, Chilli Powder, Salt, Black Pepper
instructions: Slice your chicken breasts into bite-sized cubes. Season generously with oregano, garlic powder, paprika, cumin, chili powder, salt, black pepper, and a squeeze of lime juice. Mix thoroughly until every piece is well coated - if the color doesn't deepen, add more seasoning.

Heat a pan over medium heat and add a drizzle of olive oil or cooking spray. Cook the seasoned chicken for about 7–8 minutes, turning occasionally until golden brown and fully cooked through. Once done, remove from the pan and set aside.

In the same pan, add chopped onions and bell peppers. Sauté for 2–3 minutes until slightly soft. Then add black beans (drained and rinsed), uncooked washed rice, and all the extra seasoning for added flavor.

Toast the rice with the veggies and beans for 1–2 minutes. Pour in canned chopped tomatoes and water (enough to cover the rice by about 1 inch). Stir well and bring to a gentle boil. Cover with a lid and simmer on low heat for 12–15 minutes until the rice is fully cooked and fluffy. Stir halfway through to ensure even cooking and prevent sticking.
Once the rice is cooked, add the cooked chicken back in, along with chopped fresh coriander. Mix everything thoroughly until well combined. Taste and adjust seasoning if needed.
Divide evenly into 4 portions, garnish with extra coriander or lime wedges if desired, and ENJOY!
macroNote: Toast the uncooked rice with spices for 1–2 minutes to enhance flavor before adding liquids. After adding water, stir well, cover, and simmer on low heat for 12–15 minutes until fully cooked. Stir halfway through to prevent sticking.

title: Peri Peri Chicken Mac n Cheese
ingredients: 400g (14oz) Raw Chicken Thighs, skinless fat trimmed
1 Tsp each: Salt, Black Pepper, Onion Powder, Oregano, Paprika
instructions: Place your chicken breasts and thighs in a large dish, then marinate with minced garlic, oregano, paprika, onion powder, salt, pepper, and Nando's marinade. Mix well until the color changes and set aside to marinate.

While the chicken marinates, bring a pot of water to a boil. Add the raw macaroni pasta and boil for 7–8 minutes until al dente. Reserve some pasta water before draining the rest, then set pasta aside.
