Heat a pan over medium heat, add a little oil or cooking spray, and cook the marinated chicken for 5 minutes on each side until golden brown and juicy. Repeat in batches if needed.
Once all the chicken is cooked, set aside to rest, then chop into cubes just before serving with the mac n cheese.

In the same pan on medium heat, add chopped onions and tomato paste. Cook for about 5 minutes until softened. Then lower the heat and add milk, cream cheese, grated cheddar, extra seasonings, peri-peri hot sauce, and the reserved pasta water. Stir thoroughly until everything melts into a smooth, creamy cheese sauce.
Once the sauce is thick and creamy, add the cooked macaroni and mix well to coat. Serve evenly with the cubed chicken, and your high-protein meal prep is ready to ENJOY!
macroNote: Marinate the chicken for at least 30 minutes or overnight for the best flavor. You can use all chicken breast, all thighs, or a mix — thighs add extra juiciness and flavor. Trim any excess fat from the chicken thighs before marinating. Let the chicken rest for 5 minutes before cutting into cubes to lock in the juices. When making the sauce, keep the heat low to prevent the milk and cheese from splitting.

title: Chicken Shawarma & Crispy Fries
ingredients: 1 Tsp each: Salt, Black Pepper, Oregano, Paprika
instructions: Start by slicing the chicken breasts into butterflied halves. Place in a bowl and marinate with fresh garlic, smoked paprika, onion powder, cinnamon, cumin, salt, pepper, olive oil, tomato paste, and lemon juice. Mix thoroughly until every piece is well coated, then set aside to marinate.

While the chicken is marinating, slice the potatoes into fries and lay them flat on a lined baking tray. Season with salt, pepper, oregano, paprika, and olive oil, then toss to coat evenly. Bake or air fry at 200°C (400°F) for 20–25 minutes until golden and crispy, flipping halfway if needed.
Take a loaf tin and layer the marinated chicken slices tightly, stacking them to fill the tin completely. Bake for 25 minutes at 200°C (400°F) until cooked through and juicy with a golden top.
Once the chicken is done, let it rest for 5 minutes. Meanwhile, prepare the garlic sauce and crunchy slaw using the ingredients listed (optional: make these ahead for quicker assembly).
After resting, thinly slice the stacked chicken to reveal shawarma-style strips. Serve alongside the crispy fries, pickles, slaw, and drizzle generously with garlic sauce. Enjoy!
macroNote: Marinate the chicken as long as possible — overnight for best flavor. When layering the chicken, stack tightly to avoid pieces falling to the sides. You can also use a regular baking dish if you don't have a loaf tin. Bake the fries for 25 minutes or air fry for 15 minutes at 200°C / 400°F. Cook the chicken and fries together in the oven for 25 minutes to save time. Once the chicken is cooked and slightly cooled, slice thinly using a sharp knife and serve.

title: Crispy Sticky Orange Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 or 1 Tsp Chilli Flakes (omit for less heat)
instructions: Slice the chicken breasts into cubes, season with salt, pepper, garlic powder, and cornflour. Mix well until evenly coated — using a ziplock bag makes this easier and mess-free.
In a bowl, combine orange juice, soy sauce, honey, and orange zest — set this sauce aside for later.
Heat a pan over medium-high heat, add olive oil or butter, and cook the coated chicken for 4–5 minutes on each side until golden brown and crisp. Set aside when cooked.

In the same pan on medium heat, add chopped garlic, ginger, and chili flakes. Sauté for 1–2 minutes until fragrant, then pour in the orange sauce. Let it bubble and reduce for 3–4 minutes, then stir in a cornstarch slurry to thicken.
Once slighty thickened, return the crispy chicken to the sauce, mixing until well coated and glossy.
Meanwhile, cook your rice in a pot of water. Once cooked, serve everything evenly into portions, garnish with orange slices, green onions, and sesame seeds — then ENJOY!
macroNote: Make sure each piece of chicken is evenly coated in cornflour for the crispiest result. You can also oven-bake or air fry the chicken for a lighter, crispy option. Great for meal prep — store in the fridge for 4–5 days or freeze for longer. To reheat from frozen, microwave for 5 minutes, or thaw overnight in the fridge before reheating.

title: Creamy Steak Fajita Pasta
ingredients: 700g (25oz) Raw Topside/Top Sirloin Beef, cut into steaks
1 Tsp each: Garlic Powder, Oregano, Salt, Chilli Flakes
Extra Salt and Seasoning, to taste if needed
instructions: Slice your beef into 1-inch thick steaks, then season both sides generously with garlic powder, chili powder, salt, black pepper, and a drizzle of olive oil. Rub the spices in thoroughly until the steaks are fully coated. Set aside to marinate while you prep the rest.

Bring a pot of water to a boil and add penne pasta. Cook for 7–8 minutes until al dente. Before draining, reserve about ½ cup of pasta water to help adjust the sauce later. Drain and set the pasta aside.

In a blender cup, add milk, cream cheese, grated parmesan, garlic powder, oregano, salt, chili powder, and some of the reserved pasta water. Blend until smooth and creamy. Set aside—this will be the base of your sauce.

Get a large pan on medium-high heat, add a bit of olive oil or butter, then cook the marinated steaks for 3–4 minutes on each side until a nice golden-brown crust forms. Once cooked, set the steaks aside to rest for 5 minutes—this helps retain the juices when you slice them later.
In the same pan on medium heat, add sliced onions and bell peppers. Cook for about 5 minutes until soft and fragrant, scraping up any leftover steak bits for added flavor.

Lower the heat slightly to medium-low and pour in the creamy sauce from the blender. Let it simmer for 3–4 minutes, stirring gently, until it starts to thicken. Then add your cooked penne pasta and toss everything together until each piece of pasta is well coated and creamy.

Finally, slice the rested steaks into thin strips. Serve the creamy fajita pasta evenly into 4 portions, top each serving with sliced steak, and garnish with fresh parsley. Your high-protein meal is ready to ENJOY!
macroNote: Marinate the steak as long as possible for better tenderness and flavor. Adjust cooking time based on thickness. Use any cut of beef, but note it may change the calories. Rest the steak before slicing to keep it juicy and tender. After adding the creamy sauce and pasta in the pan, let it simmer for a few mins to allow the sauce to thicken.

title: Sticky Honey Garlic Chicken
instructions: Slice the chicken breasts into bite-sized cubes. Add minced garlic, paprika, black pepper, sriracha, and soy sauce. Mix thoroughly until the chicken is fully coated and let this marinate for enhanced flavour.

Heat a pan on medium heat, add olive oil, and cook the marinated chicken for about 8 minutes, stirring occasionally until golden and cooked through. Lower the heat completely, drizzle in honey, and stir well to glaze the chicken. Once coated, set the chicken aside.
In the same pan, add minced garlic and sauté for 1 minute until fragrant. Then add sliced red onion and bell pepper, cooking for 5 minutes until softened.

Add cooked rice to the pan, followed by soy sauce, honey, and sesame oil. Stir well until the rice is evenly coated and turns a darker color. Return the chicken to the pan along with chopped green onion, and mix everything together.
Garnish with sesame seeds. Distribute into 4 equal portions for meal prep or serve immediately and ENJOY!
macroNote: Marinate the chicken for 1–2 hours for deeper flavor. Turn off the heat before adding honey to the chicken — mix well to coat, then set aside. Sauté garlic for 1–2 minutes until fragrant before adding onions and bell peppers. After adding the rice, chicken, and sauces, mix thoroughly until well combined — you can save some chicken to serve on top for presentation.

title: Chicken Pad Thai Noodles
ingredients: Squeeze of Lime Juice to finish
instructions: Slice the chicken breasts into small cubes and place in a bowl. Add soy sauce, black pepper, garlic, and chili flakes. Mix thoroughly until the chicken is evenly coated — the color should deepen. Set aside to marinate while you prep the rest.
In a separate bowl, make the Pad Thai sauce by combining soy sauce, tamarind paste, honey, fish sauce, sriracha, and lime juice. Whisk until fully combined and smooth, then set aside for later.
Heat a pan over medium heat and add a drizzle of olive oil. Cook the marinated chicken for 3–4 minutes on each side until golden brown and cooked through. Once done, remove and set aside.

In the same pan, add a little more oil if needed. Add freshly chopped garlic, onion, and the white part of green onion. Sauté for 2–3 minutes until soft and fragrant. Push the veg to one side of the pan, crack in 3 eggs, and scramble them, stirring constantly until cooked.

Once the eggs are scrambled, mix them into the cooked vegetables. Push everything to one side of the pan and add your cooked rice noodles along with the sauce you made earlier. Toss everything together until the noodles are fully coated in sauce and take on a deep golden color.

Add the cooked chicken back to the pan along with green onion and bean sprouts. Give everything a final mix until well combined and heated through. Garnish with crushed peanuts, extra chili flakes, and a squeeze of lime juice, then serve and ENJOY!
macroNote: Make sure the Pad Thai sauce is slightly thick — adjust with more tamarind paste if needed. Avoid adding it too watery, as it should coat the noodles well. Add garnishes (peanuts, chili flakes, lime) right before serving to keep them fresh and crunchy. Distribute into 4 equal portions for meal prep. To reheat, simply microwave or warm in a pan over low heat for a few minutes.

title: Cheesy Garlic Steak & Sweet Potato Bites
ingredients: 800g (28oz) Raw Topside/Top Sirloin Beef, 1 inch cubed
instructions: Start by slicing your steaks into bite-sized cubes. Place in a mixing bowl, add minced garlic, salt, black pepper, parsley, and olive oil. Mix thoroughly until every piece is well coated, then set aside to marinate while you prep the potatoes.

Slice your sweet potatoes into small, even cubes for faster and even cooking. Add to a bowl, season with salt, pepper, paprika, parsley, minced garlic, and a drizzle of olive oil (optional for extra crispiness). Toss until all pieces are well coated.
Lay the seasoned sweet potatoes out evenly on a lined sheet pan without overcrowding. Bake or air fry at 200°C (400°F) for 17–19 minutes, shaking halfway through, until golden and crispy.

While the potatoes cook, heat a pan over medium-high heat, add light butter, and cook the steak bites for 2–3 minutes per side until a deep golden-brown crust forms. Avoid overcrowding to ensure a good sear — cook in batches if needed.
Once all steak bites are done, lower the heat, add a handful of fresh parsley, and stir well to coat in the butter and herbs.

Add the crispy sweet potatoes to the steak, toss everything together gently, then sprinkle grated cheddar over the top. Cover the pan with a lid for 1–2 minutes to melt the cheese. Finally, distribute evenly into 4 portions and ENJOY!
macroNote: Marinate the steak bites for at least 30 minutes to allow the flavors to absorb fully. Quick tip: Add 1 tsp baking soda to the steak when marinating to help tenderize it. Ensure the sweet potatoes are evenly and well-seasoned for maximum flavor. To reheat, microwave for 2–3 minutes or warm in a pan over low heat for 3–5 minutes for best texture.

title: Chicken Teriyaki Fried Rice
ingredients: 200g (7oz) Uncooked White Rice/500g (17.5oz) Cooked Rice (leftover/day old rice is best)
instructions: Slice the chicken breast into bite-sized cubes, then add soy sauce, all-purpose seasoning, and olive oil. Mix thoroughly until well coated and set aside to marinate.
In a separate bowl, make the teriyaki sauce by combining soy sauce, honey, minced garlic, cornflour (or cornstarch), and water. Mix until smooth and set aside for later.
Heat a pan over medium-high heat, add cooking spray or a little olive oil, add the beaten eggs then scramble for 2–3 minutes until fluffy. Remove from the pan and set aside.

In the same pan on medium high heat, cook the marinated chicken for about 7–8 minutes until golden brown. Lower the heat then pour in the teriyaki sauce, mix and let it bubble and thicken for 2–3 minutes until all pieces are well coated, then set the chicken aside.

Using the same pan, add a bit more oil if needed, then sauté chopped onions, ginger, carrots, peas, and bean sprouts for 5–8 minutes until soft and fragrant. Add cooked white rice, soy sauce, and oyster sauce. Stir well to combine.

Add the teriyaki chicken, scrambled eggs, and green onions to the fried rice mixture. Mix everything thoroughly until well combined. Garnish with sesame seeds and distribute into 4 even portions and ENJOY!
macroNote: Marinate the chicken for at least 30 minutes (or longer) for deeper flavor. Scramble the eggs on medium high heat, stirring constantly for 3–4 minutes until fluffy — don't overcook. Cook the chicken on high heat, stirring frequently to develop a golden brown color. Once browned, add the sauce on medium heat, let it thicken, then remove from heat with all the sauce. When cooking the vegetables, make sure the carrots have fully softened before adding the rice.

title: Cheesy Beef Loaded Fries
ingredients: 1/2 Tsp each: Salt, Garlic and Onion Powder
instructions: Slice the potatoes into fries, then season with salt, oregano, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, cumin, and olive oil. Toss until evenly coated, then oven bake or air fry for about 20 minutes at 200°C (400°F) until golden and crispy then set aside.
For the garlic sauce, combine yoghurt, mayo, salt, garlic powder, onion powder, and squeeze of lime juice in a bowl. Mix until smooth and creamy, then set aside.
Heat a pan over medium-high heat, add light butter and chopped onions. Sauté for about 8 minutes until soft and caramelised, then remove and set aside.

In the same pan, cook the minced beef on medium-high heat for 6 minutes until browned. Add 1 serving taco spice mix and the caramelised onions. Cook for another 4–5 minutes until well combined and the beef deepens in color.
Lower the heat, sprinkle over cheddar cheese, and cover the pan for a minute or two until the cheese melts.

Divide the crispy fries into portions, top with the cheesy taco beef, freshly chopped red onion, jalapenos, tomatoes, fresh coriander then drizzle generously with garlic sauce and sriracha, and ENJOY!
macroNote: Mix fries thoroughly to ensure they're fully coated, then oven bake or air fry at 200°C for 17–20 minutes until crispy. Sauté the onions on medium heat until soft and caramelised—this adds a rich flavour to the beef. Cook the beef on high heat until browned, then add seasoning and continue cooking for 4–5 minutes until golden and seared. Make the garlic sauce in batches and store in the fridge—it keeps well and works great for other meals too.

title: Cheesy BBQ Chicken & Crispy Potatoes
ingredients: 2 Tsp Olive Oil or Cooking Spray
instructions: Start by slicing your chicken breasts into bite-sized cubes. Season with salt, oregano, chili flakes, onion powder, paprika, and olive oil. Mix thoroughly until well coated, then set aside to marinate.
Chop your potatoes into small cubes. Season with salt, garlic powder, paprika, oregano, and olive oil. Toss until every piece is evenly coated.
Spread the seasoned potatoes out on a lined sheet pan in a single layer. Oven bake at 200°C (400°F) for 20 minutes or air fry for 18 minutes until golden and crispy.
Heat a pan over medium heat, melt a bit of butter, then cook the marinated chicken for 6–8 minutes until golden brown and cooked through.
Once the chicken is cooked, lower the heat, then stir in extra butter, minced garlic, chopped parsley, and drizzle of BBQ sauce. Using a spatula, mix until the chicken is well coated and glazed.
Add the crispy potatoes to the pan and mix with the chicken till well incorporated. Sprinkle over shredded mozzarella, cover with a lid on low heat, and let it melt for 2–3 minutes.
Once the cheese is melted and gooey, drizzle with extra BBQ sauce, divide into four equal portions, and your high protein meal prep is ready to ENJOY!
macroNote: Cook the chicken over medium heat to avoid drying it out, then reduce to low heat before adding the garlic, parsley, and BBQ sauce. Stir everything together until the chicken is well coated and glazed—this creates a rich, smoky flavour. Add the cheese while the pan is on low heat, then cover to let it melt. You can add a splash of water to help it steam and melt faster. Store in the fridge for up to 4 days or freeze for longer. Reheat in the air fryer or oven until hot and crispy.

title: One-Pan Tomato Chicken
ingredients: 1/2 Tsp each: Garlic Powder, Paprika, Dried Basil, Salt, Black Pepper
200g (7oz) Uncooked Basmati Rice/540g Cooked Rice (140g per serving)
instructions: Slice your chicken breasts into thinner halves. Season both sides with garlic powder, parsley, paprika, dried basil, salt, pepper, and olive oil. Rub the seasoning in until evenly coated.
Heat a pan over medium heat, then cook the seasoned chicken for 4–5 minutes on the first side until golden and slightly charred. Flip and cook the other side for 2–3 minutes.
Pour in canned chopped tomatoes around the chicken along with thinly sliced red onion. Sprinkle in a bit more seasoning for extra flavour.
Gently mix the onions and tomatoes together, spreading evenly around the chicken. Cover with a lid and simmer on low heat for 10 minutes, stirring halfway to blend the flavours.
Meanwhile, boil your rice in a pot of water until cooked. Once done, serve alongside the saucy chicken. Garnish with fresh parsley and ENJOY!
macroNote: Cook the chicken on medium heat until golden, then flip before adding the canned tomatoes. If needed, layer any remaining chicken pieces on top before covering the pan. Simmer for 10 minutes on low heat, stirring occasionally to let the flavours develop.

title: Beef Chilli
ingredients: 250g (8.8oz) Raw Basmati or Long Grain Rice
instructions: Start by prepping all your vegetables - finely chop the onion, red and green bell peppers, and mince the garlic. Wash your rice and set it aside for later.
Now cook all your vegetables in a pan.
In the same pan, add the ground beef and cook over medium-high heat for 8–10 minutes until fully browned and no pink remains. Use a spatula to break up the meat continuously for an even texture.

Add the cooked veggies back into the pan along with tomato paste, salt, oregano, onion powder, smoked paprika, cumin, and chili powder. Stir well for 1–2 minutes until the spices are toasted and the meat turns a rich golden brown.

Lower the heat to medium-low, then stir in the canned chopped tomatoes, chopped pickled jalapeños, and 300-400ml of beef broth. Mix everything thoroughly, then cover with a lid and let it simmer on low heat for 15–20 minutes.

While the chili simmers, prepare the rice. In a separate pot, bring water to a boil, add the raw rice, and simmer on low heat for 8–10 minutes until fully cooked and fluffy. Drain any excess water, then stir in a big handful of chopped coriander, the juice of one lime, and salt to taste. Mix well and set aside.

After the chili has simmered for 15 minutes, remove the lid and add the red kidney beans. Stir to combine, then simmer uncovered for another 5 minutes. If the sauce is too thick, add a splash of beef broth or water to adjust consistency.

To serve, divide the coriander lime rice evenly into 5 containers. Top with the beef chili, then garnish with shredded cheese, chopped coriander, and green onion. Your high-protein meals are ready to ENJOY!

title: Korean BBQ Chicken
ingredients: Gochujang Spicy Sauce (big batch, store in bottle):
instructions: Trim any excess fat from your boneless chicken thighs, then place them in a large mixing bowl. Add black pepper, garlic paste, ginger paste, gochujang, sriracha, sesame seeds, and light soy sauce. Mix thoroughly until the chicken is fully coated and the colour deepens. Set aside to marinate for at least 1 hour, or overnight for more intense flavour. You can also freeze the raw marinated chicken and defrost it whenever you need a quick protein base for the week.

When ready to cook, spread the marinated chicken thighs evenly in a single layer on a lined sheet pan (baking paper/parchment paper). Oven bake or air fry at 200°C / 400°F for 16-18 minutes, until the chicken is cooked through, juicy, and has a light golden char on the edges.

Let the chicken thighs rest for 3-4 minutes, then leave them whole for storage. Keeping the thighs intact helps retain their natural juices and prevents them from drying out over the week. Make sure to pack all the resting juices from the sheet pan together with the chicken when storing. These juices are essential for extra flavour and help keep the chicken moist during storage and reheating, ensuring nothing gets wasted.

Allow the chicken to cool completely, then store the whole pieces in airtight glass containers and refrigerate for the week. Slice or cube the chicken only when serving to maintain maximum tenderness and juiciness. ENJOY!

title: Bang Bang Chicken
ingredients: 1500g (53oz / 3.3lbs) Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, cubed
60g (2.1oz / 4 Tbsp) Reduced Sugar Sweet Chilli Sauce
instructions: Slice the boneless, skinless chicken thighs into bite-sized cubes. Place them in a large bowl and season with salt, black pepper, garlic powder, onion powder, smoked paprika, ginger powder, and olive oil. Mix thoroughly until the chicken is evenly coated and the colour deepens. Set aside to marinate.

To make the bang bang sauce, combine light mayo, yogurt, sweet chilli sauce, sriracha, rice vinegar, and freshly chopped parsley in a bowl. Mix until smooth. Separate a small amount of this sauce into another bowl - this will be used to baste the chicken during cooking.

Spread the marinated chicken cubes in a single layer on a lined sheet pan. Use a brush to lightly coat each piece with the reserved bang bang sauce. Bake or air fry at 200°C / 400°F for 22-25 minutes until golden and slightly crispy. Once cooked, while the chicken is still hot, brush over a final layer of bang bang sauce to create a glossy, flavour-packed glaze.

Allow the chicken to cool slightly, then store the chicken whole as cubes in airtight containers, making sure to include any tray juices for extra flavour and moisture. Keep a portion of the bang bang sauce stored separately in a small bottle or airtight container in the fridge. This is ideal for adding extra sauce when serving or when reheating the chicken throughout the week for maximum flavour and moisture retention, ENJOY!

title: Garlic Herb Cajun Chicken
instructions: Get your boneless, skinless chicken thighs and place them in a large bowl. Season with salt, Italian herbs, chilli flakes, parsley, garlic powder, onion powder and paprika, then drizzle over the olive oil. Mix thoroughly until the chicken is well coated and fully combined.
Place all the chicken thighs flat and evenly spread on a lined sheet pan. Oven bake or air fry at 200°C / 400°F for 22-25 minutes. The chicken should come out golden and charred on the edges.

Once cooked, let the chicken rest for 4-5 minutes. For best meal prep results, store the chicken whole to help retain juices and prevent drying out over the week. Make sure to include any tray juices when storing for extra flavour and moisture. Slice into cubes only when serving, or leave whole depending on preference. Store in large airtight glass containers and enjoy a delicious protein source ready for the week, ENJOY!

title: Tandoori Chicken
ingredients: 1500g (53oz / 3.3lbs) Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, trim excess fat
4 Tsp Tandoori Masala (salt included) Brand: Shaan
instructions: Trim any excess fat from the boneless chicken thighs, then place them in a large mixing bowl. Season with tandoori masala, black pepper, smoked paprika, garlic powder, cumin, and coriander powder, then add olive oil, yogurt, and a squeeze of lemon juice. Mix well until fully combined and the colour deepens. Set aside to marinate - the longer it rests, the more intense the flavour will be.

Line a sheet pan with parchment paper. Spread the marinated chicken thighs in a single layer and sprinkle a little extra tandoori seasoning on top. Oven bake or air fry at 200°C / 400°F for 20-25 minutes, until cooked through, golden and crispy on the edges. Once the chicken is cooked, set it aside to rest.

For best meal prep results, keep the chicken whole when storing to retain juiciness. Make sure to include any resting juices from the sheet pan with the chicken for extra flavour and moisture. Slice into cubes only when serving for maximum tenderness. ENJOY!

title: Honey Chipotle Chicken
ingredients: 100g (3.5oz) Chipotle Paste or Chipotle Peppers in Adobo
Chipotle Sauce (big batch, store in bottle):
instructions: Place the boneless, skinless chicken thighs in a bowl and season with salt, oregano, garlic powder, smoked paprika, cumin, chipotle paste, honey, and fresh lime juice. Mix thoroughly until the chicken is fully coated and deeply coloured, then set aside to marinate.

Lay the marinated chicken thighs evenly on a lined sheet pan, then scatter pineapple chunks around the chicken. This allows the pineapple to caramelise and soften while releasing extra sweetness and moisture that enhances the flavour of the chicken. Oven bake or air fry at 200°C / 400°F for 20-23 minutes, or until golden, juicy, and slightly charred at the edges, with the pineapple lightly caramelised.

While the chicken rests, make the pineapple chipotle sauce. In a blender cup add yogurt, mayo, chipotle paste, pineapple chunks, salt, garlic powder, onion powder, and lime juice. Blend for 30-60 seconds until completely smooth and creamy.

Bottle up the sauce for the week (great for wraps and bowls). For meal prep, keep the chicken whole when storing to retain juiciness, and include any tray juices for extra flavour and moisture. Allow the chicken to cool completely, then store the whole thighs in airtight containers. Slice into bite-sized cubes only when serving for maximum flavour and moisture retention and add the pineapple chipotle sauce as needed throughout the week. ENJOY!

title: Chicken Shawarma
ingredients: Special Garlic White Sauce (big batch, store in bottle):
40g (1.4oz) Pickle Juice, add to desired consistency
instructions: Place the boneless, skinless chicken thighs into a large mixing bowl. Add minced garlic, shawarma spices (paprika, onion powder, cumin, cinnamon, sumac, salt, pepper), tomato paste, olive oil, and a squeeze of fresh lemon juice. Mix thoroughly until the chicken is evenly coated and vibrant in colour. Set aside to marinate for at least 30 minutes - longer develops deeper flavour.

For the Garlic White Sauce, combine yogurt, light mayo, honey, salt, black pepper, garlic powder, and pickle juice. Mix until smooth and creamy, then bottle and store in the fridge. It will keep well for multiple meals throughout the week.

Spread the marinated chicken thighs evenly on a lined sheet pan. Bake or air fry at 200°C / 400°F for 20-23 minutes, until golden, slightly charred, and juicy. Once cooked, let the chicken rest for 5 minutes. For meal prep, keep the chicken whole when storing and slice into cubes only when serving.

title: Orange Chicken
ingredients: 1500g (53oz / 3.3lbs) Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, cubed
instructions: Slice the boneless, skinless chicken thighs into bite-size cubes and place them in a mixing bowl. Add black pepper, minced garlic, ginger paste, red pepper flakes, honey, sriracha, freshly squeezed orange juice, orange zest, and dark soy sauce. Mix thoroughly until the chicken is fully coated and vibrant in colour. Set aside to marinate for at least 30 minutes (or overnight for deeper flavour).

Line a baking tray with baking paper, then spread the marinated chicken evenly in a single layer. Oven bake or air fry at 200°C / 400°F for 19-22 minutes, until golden brown and slightly charred on the edges. Let it rest for a few minutes, making sure to keep all the flavourful juices.
For meal prep, store the chicken as whole cubes and include all the tray juices to keep it juicy throughout the week.

title: Orange Pepper Chicken
ingredients: 1500g (53oz / 3.3lbs) Raw Boneless Skinless Chicken Thighs, trim excess fat
Juice + Zest of 1 Large Orange (add orange pulp for extra caramelised texture)
instructions: Trim any excess fat from the boneless chicken thighs, then place them in a large mixing bowl. Add salt, black pepper, garlic powder, honey, sriracha, fresh orange juice, orange zest, and light soy sauce. Mix thoroughly until fully combined and the colour deepens. Set aside to marinate for at least 30 minutes.

Line a sheet pan with parchment paper. Spread the marinated chicken evenly in a single layer. Sprinkle a little extra garlic powder and black pepper, then. add a touch more orange juice and zest over the top to help create a sticky, caramelised glaze as it cooks Air fry or oven bake at 200°C / 400°F for 25-27 minutes, until golden brown, sizzling, and slightly charred.

Once cooked, allow the chicken to rest for a few minutes, then keep the thighs whole for storage. Pour in all the sheet-pan juices for added moisture and flavour. Slice into juicy cubes only when serving for maximum tenderness.

title: Chipotle Ground Beef
ingredients: Splash of Water (optional, if needed for moisture)
instructions: Prepare the creamy chipotle sauce. In a blender, combine Greek yogurt, light mayo, chipotle paste, honey, lime juice, salt, garlic powder, and paprika. Blend until completely smooth, then bottle and refrigerate. This sauce keeps well for the entire week.
Heat a pan over high heat, melt the reduced fat butter, then add the ground beef. Cook for 6-8 minutes, breaking it apart, until browned and fully cooked.

Reduce the heat to medium. Add salt, garlic powder, onion powder, parsley, paprika, cumin, and chipotle paste. Mix thoroughly so the spices coat the beef evenly. If the mixture seems dry, add a small splash of water. Finish with a drizzle of honey and cook until the beef becomes juicy, flavourful, and lightly caramelised. Remove from heat. For meal prep, allow the beef to cool, then store it as is (do not press, pack, or shred).

title: Taco Ground Beef
ingredients: (For 1000g beef, use 2 servings of this spice mix.)
Chipotle Spicy Sauce (big batch - stores for the week):
instructions: MAKE THE TACO SPICE MIX Combine salt, black pepper, onion powder, garlic powder, cumin, paprika, chilli powder, and oregano. Double the amounts to create 2 servings for the beef.
MAKE THE CHIPOTLE SPICY SAUCE Blend the yogurt, mayo, chipotle paste, buffalo hot sauce, honey, salt, paprika, and garlic powder until smooth and creamy. Bottle and refrigerate for up to one week.

COOK THE TACO BEEF Heat a pan over medium-high heat and melt the butter. Add the ground beef and cook for 8-10 minutes, breaking it apart until fully browned. Stir in the tomato paste and 2 servings of taco spice mix, then cook for another 3-4 minutes until juicy, seasoned, and lightly caramelised.
FINISH & STORE Top the cooked beef with shredded mozzarella. Store the beef in glass containers and cool completely before refrigerating.

title: Chilli Lime Chicken
instructions: PREP & MARINATE THE CHICKEN Trim excess fat from the chicken thighs and place them in a large mixing bowl. Add salt, black pepper, minced garlic, chilli flakes, smoked paprika, honey, lime zest, lime juice, and light soy sauce. Mix thoroughly with your hands until the chicken is fully coated and the colour deepens. Set aside to marinate for at least 30 minutes (longer gives deeper flavour).

MAKE THE AHI VERDE SAUCE In a blender, combine Greek yogurt, light mayo, honey, deseeded green chilli, fresh coriander, salt, and pepper. Blend until completely smooth, then bottle and refrigerate for the week.

COOK THE CHICKEN Spread the marinated chicken thighs evenly on a lined sheet pan, ensuring they sit in a single layer for even browning. Oven bake or air fry at 200°C / 400°F for 20-22 minutes, until juicy with lightly charred edges.

REST & STORE THE CHICKEN Let the chicken rest for 5 minutes to retain its juices. For meal prep, store the chicken whole in airtight glass containers and include all resting juices for maximum flavour and moisture. Slice into cubes only when serving.

title: Honey Chilli Crisp Chicken
ingredients: 1500g (53oz / 3.3lbs) Raw Boneless Chicken Thighs, trim excess fat
80g (2.1oz) Chilli Crisp Oil, drained well to keep mostly the crisp
instructions: PREP & MARINATE THE CHICKEN Trim any excess fat from the boneless chicken thighs, then place them in a mixing bowl. Add salt, black pepper, garlic powder, paprika, chilli crisp (mostly the crisp, minimal oil), and honey. Mix thoroughly with your hands until the chicken is evenly coated and the colour deepens. Set aside to marinate for at least 30 minutes.
COOK THE CHICKEN Spread the marinated chicken thighs evenly on a lined sheet pan. Oven bake or air fry at 190°C / 385°F for 16-18 minutes, until golden brown, juicy, and lightly charred on the edges.

REST & STORE THE CHICKEN (KEEP THIGHS WHOLE) Once the chicken is cooked, allow it to rest for 5 minutes. For meal prep purposes, keep the chicken whole to retain maximum juiciness throughout the week. Pour all the tray juices over the thighs - this adds flavour, prevents drying, and enhances the honey chilli glaze as it cools. Slice into cubes only when serving to maintain the best texture and moisture. Enjoy your flavour packed, high protein chicken for the week!

title: Korean Ground Beef
instructions: MAKE THE KOREAN MARINADE In a mixing bowl, combine light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, honey, minced garlic, and gochujang. Mix until smooth and fully combined. This marinade will be used for both the beef and optional rice.

COOK THE BEEF Heat a pan over medium-high heat. Add a small amount of olive oil if needed, then cook the 1000g minced beef for about 6-8 minutes, breaking it apart with a spatula until fully browned with no pink remaining.

ADD THE MARINADE & STORE Lower the heat to medium, then add half of the prepared Korean sauce, the chopped green onions, and sesame seeds. Stir well and cook for 4-5 minutes until the beef becomes glossy, golden, and slightly caramelised. Once done, remove from heat and transfer the cooked beef into airtight glass containers, spreading it evenly so it cools quickly before storing for meal prep.

title: Garlic Herb Chicken
instructions: MARINATE THE CHICKEN Place the chicken thighs in a large mixing bowl. Add garlic paste, salt, black pepper, mixed herbs, parsley, paprika, chilli flakes, and olive oil. Mix thoroughly until every piece is coated and the colour deepens. Set aside to marinate.

COOK UNTIL GOLDEN Heat a pan over medium heat and melt the butter. Add the chicken thighs in a single layer and cook for 5-6 minutes per side until a deep golden crust forms and the chicken is cooked through. Remove and set aside to rest, then repeat with the remaining chicken.

MEAL PREP STORAGE Keep the chicken whole for storing (this prevents moisture loss). Let it rest fully, then transfer the thighs to airtight glass containers along with the buttery pan juices for flavour. Slice into cubes only when serving to keep each portion juicy and tender. ENJOY!

title: Teriyaki Ground Beef
ingredients: Dash of Milk for desired consistency
instructions: MAKE THE TERIYAKI SAUCE BASE In a bowl, mix together light soy sauce, dark soy sauce, honey/maple syrup, rice vinegar, and minced garlic. This will be used to flavour the beef once browned.
BROWN THE BEEF Heat a pan over medium-high heat and melt the light butter. Add the ground beef and cook for 6-8 minutes, breaking it apart with a spatula until fully browned with no pink remaining.

ADD THE FLAVOUR Lower the heat to medium. Add all of the prepared teriyaki sauce, plus green onions and sesame seeds. Stir well and cook for another 4-5 minutes until the beef becomes golden, juicy, and slightly sticky. Transfer to airtight glass containers and allow to cool before storing.

title: Nacho Ground Beef
ingredients: 1/2-1 Tsp Chilli Powder (adjust heat to preference)
(For 1400g beef, use 3 servings of this spice mix.)
instructions: COOK THE BEEF Heat a large pan over medium high heat, add the butter, then cook the ground beef for 5-7 minutes, breaking it apart with a spatula until fully browned with no pink remaining.

ADD SEASONINGS Once browned, stir in the taco spice mix, tomato paste, chopped jalapeños, and jalapeño juice. Cook for 2 more minutes until the flavours intensify and the beef turns juicy and fragrant. Set aside.

MAKE THE NACHO CHEESE SAUCE Using the same pan on low heat, add the evaporated milk, American cheese slices, cheddar, and a splash of jalapeño juice (optional). Stir continuously until the cheese melts and the sauce becomes silky and smooth. Transfer to a container and refrigerate for later use.

title: Beef Shawarma
instructions: MARINATE THE BEEF Thinly slice the sirloin beef into extra thin strips. Place in a large mixing bowl and add 2.5 servings of shawarma spice mix, olive oil, and lemon juice. Mix thoroughly until fully coated and set aside to marinate.
PREPARE THE ONION MIX In a separate bowl, combine the thinly sliced red onion, chopped parsley, sumac, and lemon juice. Mix well and set aside. This will be used as a fresh topping.

COOK THE BEEF Heat a pan on high heat and melt some of the butter. Sear the marinated beef for 1-2 minutes to get a quick char. Reduce heat to medium, add the remaining butter and parsley, and sauté for another 1-2 minutes until evenly coated and golden brown. Remove the beef from the pan and set aside. Repeat until all beef is cooked.
